translations.idiomatic: Cheng also passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to commissioner staffs.

sentences.zh: 牛僧孺，字思黯，隋僕射奇章公弘之後。

translations.literal: Niu Sengru, styled Si'an, was a descendant of Duke Qizhang Niu Hong, Minister of Works of the Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Sengru, styled Si'an, was a descendant of Duke Qizhang Niu Hong, Minister of Works of the Sui.

sentences.zh: 祖紹。

translations.literal: His grandfather Shao.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Shao.

sentences.zh: 父幼簡，官卑。

translations.literal: His father Youjian held low office.
translations.idiomatic: His father Youjian held low office.

sentences.zh: 僧孺進士擢第，登賢良方正制科，釋褐伊闕尉，遷監察御史，轉殿中，歷禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: Sengru was selected through the jinshi examination, passed the Exceptionally Qualified and Upright recruitment, left office as warden of Yique, was promoted to Investigating Censor, transferred to the Palace, and served as Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru was selected through the jinshi examination, passed the Exceptionally Qualified and Upright recruitment, left office as warden of Yique, was promoted to Investigating Censor, transferred to the Palace, and served as Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 元和中，改都官，知臺雜，尋換考功員外郎，充集賢直學士。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe era he was changed to the Bureau of Punishments, directed palace censorial affairs, soon changed to Vice Director in the Bureau of Evaluations, and served as Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanhe era he was changed to the Bureau of Punishments, directed palace censorial affairs, soon changed to Vice Director in the Bureau of Evaluations, and served as Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，以庫部郎中知制誥。

translations.literal: When Emperor Muzong acceded he became Director in the Treasuries Ministry and Drafter of Imperial Edicts.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Muzong acceded he became Director in the Treasuries Ministry and Drafter of Imperial Edicts.

sentences.zh: 其年十一月，改御史中丞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of that year he was changed to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of that year he was changed to Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 以州府刑獄淹滯，人多冤抑，僧孺條疏奏請，按劾相繼，中外肅然。

translations.literal: Because prefectural prisons delayed cases and many people suffered wrongful oppression, Sengru submitted detailed memorials requesting investigation and impeachment in succession; inside and outside grew stern.
translations.idiomatic: Because prefectural prisons delayed cases and many people suffered wrongful oppression, Sengru submitted detailed memorials requesting investigation and impeachment in succession. Inside and outside grew stern.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年，宿州刺史李直臣坐贓當死，直臣賂中貴人為之申理，僧孺堅執不回。

translations.literal: In the first year of Changqing, Su Prefecture magistrate Li Zhichen was convicted of corruption and should die; Zhichen bribed inner-court favorites to plead his case, but Sengru firmly held and did not yield.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changqing, Su Prefecture magistrate Li Zhichen was convicted of corruption and should die. Zhichen bribed inner-court favorites to plead his case, but Sengru firmly held and did not yield.

sentences.zh: 穆宗面喻之曰：「直臣事雖僭失，然此人有經度才，可委之邊任，朕欲貸其法。」

translations.literal: Emperor Muzong instructed him face to face: "Zhichen's matter, though excessive and wrongful, yet this man has talent for planning and may be entrusted with frontier duty—I wish to pardon him by law."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Muzong instructed him face to face: "Zhichen's matter, though excessive and wrongful, yet this man has talent for planning and may be entrusted with frontier duty. I wish to pardon him by law."

sentences.zh: 僧孺對曰：「凡人不才，止於持祿取容耳。

translations.literal: Sengru replied: "Ordinary men without talent merely hold salary and seek favor.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru replied: "Ordinary men without talent merely hold salary and seek favor.

sentences.zh: 帝王立法，束縛奸雄，正為才多者。

translations.literal: The emperor establishes law to bind treacherous heroes precisely because talent is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor establishes law to bind treacherous heroes precisely because talent is abundant.

sentences.zh: 祿山、硃泚以才過人，濁亂天下，況直臣小才，又何屈法哉？」

translations.literal: An Lushan and Zhu Ci exceeded others in talent yet troubled and disordered the realm—how much more Zhichen's small talent; why bend the law?"
translations.idiomatic: An Lushan and Zhu Ci exceeded others in talent yet troubled and disordered the realm. How much more Zhichen's small talent—why bend the law?"

sentences.zh: 上嘉其守法，面賜金紫。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his upholding of law and personally bestowed gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his upholding of law and personally bestowed gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，拜戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year he was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year he was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，以本官同平章事。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, with his regular office he became Associate Councilor of State.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, with his regular office he became Associate Councilor of State.

sentences.zh: 初，韓弘入朝，以宣武舊事，人多流言，其子公武以家財厚賂權幸及多言者，班列之中，悉受其遺。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Han Hong entered court, because of old Xuanwu affairs many spread rumors; his son Gongwu used family wealth to bribe the powerful and many speakers, and among the ranks all received his gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Han Hong entered court, because of old Xuanwu affairs many spread rumors. His son Gongwu used family wealth to bribe the powerful and many speakers, and among the ranks all received his gifts.

sentences.zh: 俄而父子俱卒，孤孫幼小，穆宗恐為廝養竊盜，乃命中使至其家，閱其宅簿，以付家老。

translations.literal: Soon father and son both died; the orphaned grandson was young; Muzong feared servants and attendants would steal; he ordered an inner-court envoy to their house to examine the household register and deliver it to the family elder.
translations.idiomatic: Soon father and son both died. The orphaned grandson was young. Muzong feared servants and attendants would steal, so he ordered an inner-court envoy to their house to examine the household register and deliver it to the family elder.

sentences.zh: 而簿上具有納賂之所，唯於僧孺官側硃書曰：「某月日，送牛侍郎物若干，不受，卻付訖。」

translations.literal: On the register were fully recorded places of bribery; only beside Sengru's office was written in red: "On such-and-such month and day, such-and-such goods sent to Vice Minister Niu—not accepted, returned and paid in full."
translations.idiomatic: On the register were fully recorded places of bribery. Only beside Sengru's office was written in red: "On such-and-such month and day, such-and-such goods sent to Vice Minister Niu—not accepted, returned and paid in full."

sentences.zh: 穆宗按簿甚悅。

translations.literal: Muzong examined the register and was very pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong examined the register and was very pleased.

sentences.zh: 居無何，議命相，帝首可僧孺之名。

translations.literal: Before long, when a chancellor was to be appointed, the emperor first approved Sengru's name.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, when a chancellor was to be appointed, the emperor first approved Sengru's name.

sentences.zh: 敬宗即位，加中書侍郎、銀青光祿大夫，封奇章子，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong acceded he was advanced to Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal, Baron of Qizhang with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong acceded he was advanced to Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal, Baron of Qizhang with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 十二月，加金紫階，進封郡公、集賢殿大學士、監修國史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was given the gold-and-purple rank, advanced to Duke of the Commandery, Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and Supervisor of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was given the gold-and-purple rank, advanced to Duke of the Commandery, Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and Supervisor of the National History.

sentences.zh: 寶歷中，朝廷政事出於邪幸，大臣朋比。

translations.literal: In the Baoli era court politics came from wicked favorites and great ministers formed factions.
translations.idiomatic: In the Baoli era court politics came from wicked favorites and great ministers formed factions.

sentences.zh: 僧孺不奈群小，拜章求罷者數四。

translations.literal: Sengru could not bear the petty men and submitted memorials begging to resign four times.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru could not bear the petty men and submitted memorials begging to resign four times.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「俟予郊禮畢放卿。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Wait until I finish the suburban sacrifice, then I will release you."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Wait until I finish the suburban sacrifice, then I will release you."

sentences.zh: 及穆宗祔廟郊報後，又拜章陳退，乃於鄂州置武昌軍額，以僧孺檢校禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事、鄂州刺史、武昌軍節度、鄂嶽蘄黃觀察等使。

translations.literal: After Muzong's ancestral temple rites and suburban report, Sengru again submitted memorials stating his withdrawal; then the Wuchang Army quota was established in E Prefecture, and Sengru was made Acting Minister of Rites, Associate Councilor of State through the Secretariat, prefect of E, military commissioner of Wuchang Army, and observation commissioner of E-Yue-Qi-Huang.
translations.idiomatic: After Muzong's ancestral temple rites and suburban report, Sengru again submitted memorials stating his withdrawal. Then the Wuchang Army quota was established in E Prefecture, and Sengru was made Acting Minister of Rites, Associate Councilor of State through the Secretariat, prefect of E, military commissioner of Wuchang Army, and observation commissioner of E-Yue-Qi-Huang.

sentences.zh: 江夏城風土散惡，難立垣墉，每年加板築，賦青茆以覆之。

translations.literal: Jiangxia city's soil was loose and bad and hard to build walls; every year additional plank construction was added and a levy of green thatch imposed for covering.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxia city's soil was loose and bad and hard to build walls. Every year additional plank construction was added and a levy of green thatch imposed for covering.

sentences.zh: 吏緣為奸，蠹弊綿歲。

translations.literal: Clerks used this for fraud; the corruption lasted years.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks used this for fraud; the corruption lasted years.

sentences.zh: 僧孺至，計茆苫板築之費，歲十余萬，即賦之以專，以當苫築之價。

translations.literal: When Sengru arrived he calculated the cost of thatch and plank construction at over one hundred thousand per year, then levied a dedicated tax in place of the thatch-and-construction price.
translations.idiomatic: When Sengru arrived he calculated the cost of thatch and plank construction at over one hundred thousand per year, then levied a dedicated tax in place of the thatch-and-construction price.

sentences.zh: 凡五年，墉皆甃葺，蠹弊永除。

translations.literal: Within five years all walls were tiled and repaired and the corruption was permanently removed.
translations.idiomatic: Within five years all walls were tiled and repaired and the corruption was permanently removed.

sentences.zh: 屬郡沔州與鄂隔江相對，虛張吏員，乃奏廢之，以其所管漢陽、汶川兩縣隸鄂州。

translations.literal: Because Mian Prefecture in his jurisdiction faced E across the river, he falsely inflated clerical posts and memorialized to abolish it, placing its subordinate counties Hanyang and Wenchuan under E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Because Mian Prefecture in his jurisdiction faced E across the river, he falsely inflated clerical posts and memorialized to abolish it, placing its subordinate counties Hanyang and Wenchuan under E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 文宗即位，就加檢校吏部尚書，凡鎮江夏五年。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenzong acceded he was advanced to Acting Minister of Personnel; in all he governed Jiangxia for five years.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenzong acceded he was advanced to Acting Minister of Personnel. In all he governed Jiangxia for five years.

sentences.zh: 太和三年，李宗閔輔政，屢薦僧孺有才，不宜居外。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taihe, when Li Zongmin assisted in government, he repeatedly recommended Sengru as talented and unfit to remain outside.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Taihe, when Li Zongmin assisted in government, he repeatedly recommended Sengru as talented and unfit to remain outside.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，召還，守兵部尚書、同平章事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year he was recalled and served as Minister of War and Associate Councilor of State.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year he was recalled and served as Minister of War and Associate Councilor of State.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，幽州軍亂，逐其帥李載義。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year the Youzhou army rebelled and drove out its commander Li Zaiyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year the Youzhou army rebelled and drove out its commander Li Zaiyi.

sentences.zh: 文宗以載義輸忠於國，遽聞失帥，駭然，急召宰臣謂之曰：「范陽之變奈何？」

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong, because Zaiyi had shown loyalty to the state, was startled on suddenly hearing he had lost command and hastily summoned the chancellors: "What shall we do about the Fanyang change?"
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong, because Zaiyi had shown loyalty to the state, was startled on suddenly hearing he had lost command and hastily summoned the chancellors: "What shall we do about the Fanyang change?"

sentences.zh: 僧孺對曰：「此不足煩聖慮。

translations.literal: Sengru replied: "This is not worth troubling imperial concern.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru replied: "This is not worth troubling imperial concern.

sentences.zh: 且范陽得失，不系國家休戚，自安、史已來，翻覆如此。

translations.literal: Moreover Fanyang's gain or loss does not tie to the state's weal or woe; since An and Shi it has reversed thus.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Fanyang's gain or loss does not tie to the state's weal or woe. Since An and Shi it has reversed thus.

sentences.zh: 前時劉總以土地歸國，朝廷耗費百萬，終不得范陽尺帛鬥粟入於天府，尋復為梗。

translations.literal: Earlier Liu Zong returned his land to the state; the court spent a million yet ultimately received not a foot of silk or peck of grain from Fanyang into the imperial treasury; soon it became obstruction again.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Liu Zong returned his land to the state. The court spent a million yet ultimately received not a foot of silk or peck of grain from Fanyang into the imperial treasury. Soon it became obstruction again.

sentences.zh: 至今誌誠，亦由前載義也，但因而撫之，俾扞奚、契丹不令入寇，朝廷所賴也。

translations.literal: Even now Zhicheng too—only soothe them accordingly; keep the Xi and Khitan from raiding, and that is what the court relies on.
translations.idiomatic: Even now Zhicheng too—only soothe them accordingly. Keep the Xi and Khitan from raiding, and that is what the court relies on.

sentences.zh: 假以節旄，必自陳力，不足以逆順治之。」

translations.literal: Grant them the staff of command and they will surely exert themselves; it is not enough to govern by compliance or resistance."
translations.idiomatic: Grant them the staff of command and they will surely exert themselves. It is not enough to govern by compliance or resistance."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「吾初不祥，思卿言是也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "At first I was inauspicious; thinking on your words is right."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "At first I was inauspicious. Thinking on your words is right."

sentences.zh: 即日命中使宣慰。

translations.literal: That day he ordered an inner-court envoy to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: That day he ordered an inner-court envoy to comfort them.

sentences.zh: 尋加門下侍郎、弘文館大學士。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was advanced to Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 六年，吐蕃遣使論董勃義入朝修好。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Tibet sent envoy Lun Dongboyi to court to seek good relations.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Tibet sent envoy Lun Dongboyi to court to seek good relations.

sentences.zh: 俄而西川節度李德裕奏，吐蕃維州守將悉怛謀以城降。

translations.literal: Soon Xichuan Military Commissioner Li Deyu reported that Tibet's Weizhou garrison commander Sidamou wished to surrender the city.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Xichuan Military Commissioner Li Deyu reported that Tibet's Weizhou garrison commander Sidamou wished to surrender the city.

sentences.zh: 德裕又上利害云：「若以生羌三千，出戎不意，燒十三橋，搗戎之腹心，可以得誌矣。」

translations.literal: Deyu also submitted advantages and disadvantages, saying: "If three thousand raw Qiang are used to strike the Rong unexpectedly, burn the Thirteen Bridges, and strike the Rong's heartland, the aim can be achieved."
translations.idiomatic: Deyu also submitted advantages and disadvantages, saying: "If three thousand raw Qiang are used to strike the Rong unexpectedly, burn the Thirteen Bridges, and strike the Rong's heartland, the aim can be achieved."

sentences.zh: 上惑其事，下尚書省議，眾狀請如德裕之策。

translations.literal: The emperor was confused by the matter and sent it to the Department of State for discussion; all memorials requested following Deyu's plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was confused by the matter and sent it to the Department of State for discussion. All memorials requested following Deyu's plan.

sentences.zh: 僧孺奏曰：「此議非也。

translations.literal: Sengru memorialized: "This proposal is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru memorialized: "This proposal is wrong.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃疆土，四面萬里，失一維州，無損其勢。

translations.literal: Tibet's territory extends ten thousand li on all sides; losing one Weizhou does not harm its power.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet's territory extends ten thousand li on all sides. Losing one Weizhou does not harm its power.

sentences.zh: 況論董勃義才還，劉元鼎未到，比來修好，約罷戍兵。

translations.literal: Moreover Lun Dongboyi has just returned and Liu Yuanding has not yet arrived; recently good relations were made and garrison troops were agreed to be withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Lun Dongboyi has just returned and Liu Yuanding has not yet arrived. Recently good relations were made and garrison troops were agreed to be withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 中國禦戎，守信為上，應敵次之，今一朝失信，戎醜得以為詞。

translations.literal: For China to guard against the Rong, keeping faith is foremost and responding to the enemy second; now in one morning faith is lost and the Rong villains gain a pretext.
translations.idiomatic: For China to guard against the Rong, keeping faith is foremost and responding to the enemy second. Now in one morning faith is lost and the Rong villains gain a pretext.

sentences.zh: 聞贊普牧馬茹川，俯於秦、隴。

translations.literal: I hear the Zanpu pastures horses at Ruchuan, overlooking Qin and Long.
translations.idiomatic: I hear the Zanpu pastures horses at Ruchuan, overlooking Qin and Long.

sentences.zh: 若東襲隴阪，徑走回中，不三日抵咸陽橋，而發兵枝梧，駭動京國。

translations.literal: If they strike east at Longban, go straight to Huizhong, in less than three days they reach Xianyang Bridge; then dispatching troops to resist will shake the capital.
translations.idiomatic: If they strike east at Longban, go straight to Huizhong, in less than three days they reach Xianyang Bridge. Then dispatching troops to resist will shake the capital.

sentences.zh: 事或及此，雖得百維州，亦何補也。」

translations.literal: If matters reach this, though one gains a hundred Weizhous, what use is it?"
translations.idiomatic: If matters reach this, though one gains a hundred Weizhous, what use is it?"

sentences.zh: 上曰：「然。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "So it is."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "So it is."

sentences.zh: 遂詔西川不內維州降將。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered Xichuan not to accept Weizhou's surrendering generals.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered Xichuan not to accept Weizhou's surrendering generals.

sentences.zh: 僧孺素與德裕仇怨，雖議邊公體，而怙德裕者以僧孺害其功，謗論沸然，帝亦以為不直。

translations.literal: Sengru had long been at odds with Deyu; though the border discussion was public, those relying on Deyu held that Sengru harmed his achievement and slander boiled; the emperor also thought him unjust.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru had long been at odds with Deyu. Though the border discussion was public, those relying on Deyu held that Sengru harmed his achievement and slander boiled. The emperor also thought him unjust.

sentences.zh: 其年十二月，檢校左僕射、兼平章事、揚州大都督府長史、淮南節度副大使、知節度事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year he was made Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State, Associate Councilor of State, Chief Administrator of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Yang, Vice Military Commissioner of Huainan, and acting military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of that year he was made Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State, Associate Councilor of State, Chief Administrator of the Metropolitan Prefecture of Yang, Vice Military Commissioner of Huainan, and acting military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時中尉王守澄用事，多納纖人，竊議時政，禁中事密，莫知其說。

translations.literal: At that time Chief Eunuch Wang Shoucheng wielded power, admitted many petty men, and secretly discussed current politics; inner-palace affairs were secret and none knew what was said.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chief Eunuch Wang Shoucheng wielded power, admitted many petty men, and secretly discussed current politics. Inner-palace affairs were secret and none knew what was said.

sentences.zh: 一日，延英對宰相，文宗曰：「天下何由太平，卿等有意於此乎？」

translations.literal: One day at Yanying facing the chancellors, Emperor Wenzong said: "How may the realm attain peace—do you have intent toward this?"
translations.idiomatic: One day at Yanying facing the chancellors, Emperor Wenzong said: "How may the realm attain peace—do you have intent toward this?"

sentences.zh: 僧孺奏曰：「臣等待罪輔弼，無能康濟，然臣思太平亦無象。

translations.literal: Sengru memorialized: "We await punishment as assisting councilors and cannot bring peace and relief; yet I consider that peace also has no image.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru memorialized: "We await punishment as assisting councilors and cannot bring peace and relief. Yet I consider that peace also has no image.

sentences.zh: 今四夷不至交侵，百姓不至流散；

translations.literal: Now the four barbarians do not come to invade one another and the people do not scatter in flight;
translations.idiomatic: Now the four barbarians do not come to invade one another and the people do not scatter in flight;

sentences.zh: 上無淫虐，下無怨讟；

translations.literal: above there is no tyranny and below there is no resentment;
translations.idiomatic: above there is no tyranny and below there is no resentment;

sentences.zh: 私室無強家，公議無壅滯。

translations.literal: private houses have no powerful families and public discussion has no obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: private houses have no powerful families and public discussion has no obstruction.

sentences.zh: 雖未及至理，亦謂小康。

translations.literal: Though we have not yet reached perfect order, this may be called modest prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Though we have not yet reached perfect order, this may be called modest prosperity.

sentences.zh: 陛下若別求太平，非臣等所及。」

translations.literal: If Your Majesty separately seeks peace, that is not within our reach."
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty separately seeks peace, that is not within our reach."

sentences.zh: 既退至中書，謂同列曰：「吾輩為宰相，天子責成如是，安可久處茲地耶？」

translations.literal: After retiring to the Secretariat he told his colleagues: "We serve as chancellors and the Son of Heaven charges us thus—how can we long remain in this place?"
translations.idiomatic: After retiring to the Secretariat he told his colleagues: "We serve as chancellors and the Son of Heaven charges us thus—how can we long remain in this place?"

sentences.zh: 旬日間，三上章請退，不許。

translations.literal: Within ten days he submitted three memorials requesting withdrawal and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days he submitted three memorials requesting withdrawal and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 會德裕黨盛，垂將入朝，僧孺故得請。

translations.literal: When Deyu's faction flourished and he was about to enter court, Sengru therefore obtained his request.
translations.idiomatic: When Deyu's faction flourished and he was about to enter court, Sengru therefore obtained his request.

sentences.zh: 上既受左右邪說，急於太平，奸人伺其銳意，故訓、註見用。

translations.literal: The emperor had accepted wicked talk from those around him and urgently sought peace; wicked men watched his keen intent, and so Xun and Zhu were employed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had accepted wicked talk from those around him and urgently sought peace. Wicked men watched his keen intent, and so Xun and Zhu were employed.

sentences.zh: 數年之間，幾危宗社，而僧孺進退以道，議者稱之。

translations.literal: Within several years the ancestral temple was nearly endangered, yet Sengru advanced and withdrew by the Way, and commentators praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Within several years the ancestral temple was nearly endangered, yet Sengru advanced and withdrew by the Way, and commentators praised him.

sentences.zh: 開成初，搢紳道喪，閽寺弄權，僧孺嫌處重籓，求歸散地，累拜章不允，凡在淮甸六年。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaicheng the way of court gentlemen was lost and gatekeepers and temples played with power; Sengru disliked holding a heavy frontier post and sought to return to a titular post, repeatedly submitting memorials without success; in all he was in Huaidian for six years.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaicheng the way of court gentlemen was lost and gatekeepers and temples played with power. Sengru disliked holding a heavy frontier post and sought to return to a titular post, repeatedly submitting memorials without success. In all he was in Huaidian for six years.

sentences.zh: 開成二年五月，加檢校司空，食邑二千戶，判東都尚書省事、東都留守、東畿汝都防禦使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Kaicheng he was advanced to Acting Minister of Works with a fief of two thousand households, directed the Eastern Capital Department of State affairs, served as Eastern Capital Garrison Commander and Defense Commissioner of the Eastern Capital and Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Kaicheng he was advanced to Acting Minister of Works with a fief of two thousand households, directed the Eastern Capital Department of State affairs, served as Eastern Capital Garrison Commander and Defense Commissioner of the Eastern Capital and Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 僧孺識量弘遠，心居事外，不以細故介懷。

translations.literal: Sengru's judgment and capacity were broad and far-reaching; his heart dwelt outside petty affairs and he did not take small matters to heart.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru's judgment and capacity were broad and far-reaching. His heart dwelt outside petty affairs and he did not take small matters to heart.

sentences.zh: 洛都築第於歸仁裏。

translations.literal: In Luoyang he built a residence in Guiren Lane.
translations.idiomatic: In Luoyang he built a residence in Guiren Lane.

sentences.zh: 任淮南時，嘉木怪石，置之階廷，館宇清華，竹木幽邃。

translations.literal: While governing Huainan he placed fine trees and strange stones in the steps and courtyard; the buildings were clear and splendid and bamboo and trees secluded and deep.
translations.idiomatic: While governing Huainan he placed fine trees and strange stones in the steps and courtyard. The buildings were clear and splendid and bamboo and trees secluded and deep.

sentences.zh: 常與詩人白居易吟詠其間，無復進取之懷。

translations.literal: He often chanted and composed with the poet Bai Juyi among them, with no further thought of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He often chanted and composed with the poet Bai Juyi among them, with no further thought of advancement.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，征拜左僕射，仍令左軍副使王元直賫告身宣賜。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year he was summoned as Left Vice Director of the Department of State, and Left Army Vice Commissioner Wang Yuanzhi was ordered to deliver the appointment document.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year he was summoned as Left Vice Director of the Department of State, and Left Army Vice Commissioner Wang Yuanzhi was ordered to deliver the appointment document.

sentences.zh: 舊例，留守入朝，無中使賜詔例，恐僧孺退讓，促令赴闕。

translations.literal: By former precedent when a garrison commander entered court there was no precedent of an inner-court envoy bestowing an edict; fearing Sengru would decline, they urged him to hurry to court.
translations.idiomatic: By former precedent when a garrison commander entered court there was no precedent of an inner-court envoy bestowing an edict. Fearing Sengru would decline, they urged him to hurry to court.

sentences.zh: 僧孺不獲已入朝。

translations.literal: Sengru had no choice but to enter court.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru had no choice but to enter court.

sentences.zh: 屬莊恪太子初薨，延英中謝日，語及太子，乃懇陳父子君臣之義，人倫大經，不可輕移國本。

translations.literal: When the Heir Apparent Zhuangke had just died, on the day of thanks at Yanying when they spoke of the Heir Apparent he earnestly set forth the righteousness of father and son and ruler and minister—the great norm of human relations—and that the foundation of the state must not lightly be moved.
translations.idiomatic: When the Heir Apparent Zhuangke had just died, on the day of thanks at Yanying when they spoke of the Heir Apparent he earnestly set forth the righteousness of father and son and ruler and minister—the great norm of human relations—and that the foundation of the state must not lightly be moved.

sentences.zh: 上為之流涕。

translations.literal: The emperor wept for it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wept for it.

sentences.zh: 是時宰輔皆僧孺僚舊，未嘗造其門。

translations.literal: At that time the chancellors were all Sengru's old colleagues and never visited his gate.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the chancellors were all Sengru's old colleagues and never visited his gate.

sentences.zh: 上頻宣召，托以足疾。

translations.literal: The emperor repeatedly summoned him, but he pleaded foot ailment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor repeatedly summoned him, but he pleaded foot ailment.

sentences.zh: 久之，上謂楊嗣復曰：「僧孺稱疾，不任趨朝，未可即令自便。」

translations.literal: After a long time the emperor told Yang Sifu: "Sengru claims illness and cannot attend court—it is not yet time to let him go at will."
translations.idiomatic: After a long time the emperor told Yang Sifu: "Sengru claims illness and cannot attend court—it is not yet time to let him go at will."

sentences.zh: 四年八月，復檢校司空、兼平章事、襄州刺史、山南東道節度使，加食邑至三千戶。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year he was again made Acting Minister of Works, Associate Councilor of State, prefect of Xiang, and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit, with his fief increased to three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year he was again made Acting Minister of Works, Associate Councilor of State, prefect of Xiang, and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit, with his fief increased to three thousand households.

sentences.zh: 辭日，賜觚、散、樽、杓等金銀古器，令中使喻之曰：「以卿正人，賜此古器，卿且少留。」

translations.literal: On the day of leave-taking he was bestowed ancient gold and silver vessels such as goblets, ewers, wine vessels, and ladles, and an inner-court envoy instructed him: "Because you are an upright man, these ancient vessels are bestowed—please stay a while longer."
translations.idiomatic: On the day of leave-taking he was bestowed ancient gold and silver vessels such as goblets, ewers, wine vessels, and ladles, and an inner-court envoy instructed him: "Because you are an upright man, these ancient vessels are bestowed—please stay a while longer."

sentences.zh: 僧孺奏曰：「漢南水旱之後，流民待理，不宜淹留。」

translations.literal: Sengru memorialized: "After drought and flood in southern Han, displaced people await governance—it is improper to delay."
translations.idiomatic: Sengru memorialized: "After drought and flood in southern Han, displaced people await governance—it is improper to delay."

sentences.zh: 再三請行，方允。

translations.literal: He repeatedly begged to depart and was finally permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly begged to depart and was finally permitted.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，就加檢校司徒。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wuzong acceded he was advanced to Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong acceded he was advanced to Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 會昌二年，李德裕用事，罷僧孺兵權，征為太子少保，累加太子少師。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huichang, when Li Deyu wielded power, Sengru's military authority was removed; he was summoned as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and repeatedly advanced to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huichang, when Li Deyu wielded power, Sengru's military authority was removed. He was summoned as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and repeatedly advanced to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 大中初卒，贈太子太師，謚曰文貞。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Wenzhen.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Wenzhen.

sentences.zh: 僧孺少與李宗閔同門生，尤為德裕所惡。

translations.literal: In youth Sengru and Li Zongmin were fellow students; he was especially hated by Deyu.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Sengru and Li Zongmin were fellow students. He was especially hated by Deyu.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，宗閔棄斥，不為生還。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era Zongmin was cast out and did not return alive.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era Zongmin was cast out and did not return alive.

sentences.zh: 僧孺數為德裕掎摭，欲加之罪，但以僧孺貞方有素，人望式瞻，無以伺其隙。

translations.literal: Sengru was repeatedly seized and attacked by Deyu, who wished to add crimes to him, but because Sengru had long been upright and people looked to him in hope, there was no gap to watch.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru was repeatedly seized and attacked by Deyu, who wished to add crimes to him, but because Sengru had long been upright and people looked to him in hope, there was no gap to watch.

sentences.zh: 德裕南遷，所著《窮愁志》，引裏俗犢子之讖以斥僧孺。

translations.literal: When Deyu was sent south he wrote Records of Utter Woe, citing a vulgar omen of the calf to denounce Sengru.
translations.idiomatic: When Deyu was sent south he wrote Records of Utter Woe, citing a vulgar omen of the calf to denounce Sengru.

sentences.zh: 又目為「太牢公」，其相憎恨如此。

translations.literal: He also called him "Grand Sacrifice Duke"—such was their mutual hatred.
translations.idiomatic: He also called him "Grand Sacrifice Duke"—such was their mutual hatred.

sentences.zh: 僧孺二子：蔚、。

translations.literal: Sengru had two sons: Wei and Ru.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru had two sons: Wei and Ru.

sentences.zh: 蔚，字大章，十五應兩經舉。

translations.literal: Wei, styled Dazhang, at fifteen took the two classics examination.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, styled Dazhang, at fifteen took the two classics examination.

sentences.zh: 太和九年，復登進士第。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Taihe he again passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Taihe he again passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 三府辟署為從事，入朝為監察御史。

translations.literal: The three offices recruited him as an aide; he entered court as Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: The three offices recruited him as an aide. He entered court as Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 大中初，為右補闕，屢陳章疏，指斥時病。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he became Right Supplementation Official and repeatedly submitted memorials pointing out current ills.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he became Right Supplementation Official and repeatedly submitted memorials pointing out current ills.

sentences.zh: 宣宗嘉之，曰：「牛氏子有父風，差慰人意。」

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong approved and said: "Niu's son has his father's manner—somewhat comforting to the heart."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong approved and said: "Niu's son has his father's manner—somewhat comforting to the heart."

sentences.zh: 尋改司門員外郎，出為金州刺史，入拜禮、吏二郎中。

translations.literal: Soon he was changed to Vice Director in the Bureau of Gateways, went out as prefect of Jin, and entered court as Director in the Ministries of Rites and Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was changed to Vice Director in the Bureau of Gateways, went out as prefect of Jin, and entered court as Director in the Ministries of Rites and Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以祀事準禮，天官司所掌班列，有恃權越職者，蔚奏正之，為時權所忌，左授國子博士，分司東都。

translations.literal: Because sacrificial affairs followed ritual and the Heavenly Office managed court ranks, when some relied on power and overstepped office, Wei memorialized to correct it and was envied by the powerful of the time; he was demoted to Doctor of the National University, assigned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Because sacrificial affairs followed ritual and the Heavenly Office managed court ranks, when some relied on power and overstepped office, Wei memorialized to correct it and was envied by the powerful of the time. He was demoted to Doctor of the National University, assigned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 逾月，權臣罷免，復征為吏部郎中，兼史館修撰，遷左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: After a month the powerful minister was dismissed and he was again summoned as Director in the Ministry of Personnel and Compiler of the History Institute, then promoted to Left Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: After a month the powerful minister was dismissed and he was again summoned as Director in the Ministry of Personnel and Compiler of the History Institute, then promoted to Left Remonstrance Official.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，為給事中，延英謝日，面賜金紫。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era he became Supervising Censor; on the day of thanks at Yanying he was personally given gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong era he became Supervising Censor. On the day of thanks at Yanying he was personally given gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 蔚封駁無避，帝嘉之。

translations.literal: Wei reviewed and rejected without avoidance and the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: Wei reviewed and rejected without avoidance and the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，遷戶部侍郎，襲封奇章侯，以公事免。

translations.literal: After a year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue and inherited the title Marquis of Qizhang; he was dismissed for public affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue and inherited the title Marquis of Qizhang. He was dismissed for public affairs.

sentences.zh: 歲中復本官，歷工、禮、刑三尚書。

translations.literal: Within the year he regained his regular office and served successively as Minister of Works, Rites, and Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year he regained his regular office and served successively as Minister of Works, Rites, and Punishments.

sentences.zh: 咸通末，檢校兵部尚書、興元尹、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: At the end of Xiantong he was made Acting Minister of War, Metropolitan Governor of Xingyuan, and military commissioner of Shannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Xiantong he was made Acting Minister of War, Metropolitan Governor of Xingyuan, and military commissioner of Shannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 在鎮三年。

translations.literal: He was in his post three years.
translations.idiomatic: He was in his post three years.

sentences.zh: 時中官用事，急於賄賂。

translations.literal: At that time inner-court eunuchs wielded power and urgently sought bribes.
translations.idiomatic: At that time inner-court eunuchs wielded power and urgently sought bribes.

sentences.zh: 屬徐方用兵，兩中尉諷諸籓貢奉助軍，蔚盡索軍府之有三萬端匹，隨表進納。

translations.literal: When troops were used in Xu region the two chief eunuchs hinted that the various frontier posts should offer tribute to aid the army; Wei gathered all thirty thousand bolts of cloth and silk in the military prefecture and submitted them with his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: When troops were used in Xu region the two chief eunuchs hinted that the various frontier posts should offer tribute to aid the army. Wei gathered all thirty thousand bolts of cloth and silk in the military prefecture and submitted them with his memorial.

sentences.zh: 中官怒，即以神策將吳行魯代還。

translations.literal: The inner-court eunuchs were angry and replaced him with Shence General Wu Xinglu.
translations.idiomatic: The inner-court eunuchs were angry and replaced him with Shence General Wu Xinglu.

sentences.zh: 及黃巢犯闕，乃自京師奔遁，避地山南，拜章請老，以尚書左僕射致仕。

translations.literal: When Huang Chao violated the capital he fled from the capital to take refuge in Shannan, submitted a memorial requesting retirement, and was retired as Left Vice Director of the Department of State.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Chao violated the capital he fled from the capital to take refuge in Shannan, submitted a memorial requesting retirement, and was retired as Left Vice Director of the Department of State.

sentences.zh: 卒，累贈太尉。

translations.literal: When he died he was repeatedly posthumously advanced to Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: When he died he was repeatedly posthumously advanced to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 子循、徽。

translations.literal: His sons Xun and Hui.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Xun and Hui.

sentences.zh: 徽，咸通八年登進士第，三佐諸侯府，得殿中侍御史，賜緋魚。

translations.literal: Hui passed the jinshi examination in the eighth year of Xiantong, served three times as aide in commissioner staffs, became Attending Censor in the Palace, and was given crimson fish.
translations.idiomatic: Hui passed the jinshi examination in the eighth year of Xiantong, served three times as aide in commissioner staffs, became Attending Censor in the Palace, and was given crimson fish.

sentences.zh: 入朝為右補闕，再遷吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: He entered court as Right Supplementation Official and was twice promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Right Supplementation Official and was twice promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 乾符中，選曹猥濫，吏為奸弊，每歲選人四千余員。

translations.literal: In the Qianfu era the Selection Bureau was corrupt and clerks committed fraud; each year over four thousand candidates were selected.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianfu era the Selection Bureau was corrupt and clerks committed fraud. Each year over four thousand candidates were selected.

sentences.zh: 徽性貞剛，特為奏請。

translations.literal: Hui's nature was upright and firm and he specially submitted a memorial requesting reform.
translations.idiomatic: Hui's nature was upright and firm and he specially submitted a memorial requesting reform.

sentences.zh: 由是銓敘稍正，能否旌別，物議稱之。

translations.literal: Because of this selection and appointment gradually became correct, ability and inability were distinguished, and public opinion praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this selection and appointment gradually became correct, ability and inability were distinguished, and public opinion praised him.

sentences.zh: 巢賊犯京師，父蔚方病，徽與其子自扶籃輿，投竄山南。

translations.literal: When the Chao bandits violated the capital his father Wei was then ill; Hui and his son themselves supported a bamboo litter and fled into the recesses of Shannan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chao bandits violated the capital his father Wei was then ill. Hui and his son themselves supported a bamboo litter and fled into the recesses of Shannan.

sentences.zh: 閣路險狹，盜賊縱橫，谷中遇盜，擊徽破首，流血被體，而捉輿不輟。

translations.literal: The mountain paths were dangerous and narrow, bandits ran rampant, and in the valley they met bandits who struck Hui and broke his head; blood covered his body yet he did not stop holding the litter.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain paths were dangerous and narrow and bandits ran rampant. In the valley they met bandits who struck Hui and broke his head. Blood covered his body yet he did not stop holding the litter.

sentences.zh: 盜苦迫之，徽拜之曰：「父年高疾甚，不欲駭動。

translations.literal: The bandits pressed him hard; Hui bowed to them and said: "My father is advanced in years and gravely ill—I do not wish to startle him.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits pressed him hard. Hui bowed to them and said: "My father is advanced in years and gravely ill—I do not wish to startle him.

sentences.zh: 人皆有父，幸相垂恤。」

translations.literal: All men have fathers—please show mercy."
translations.idiomatic: All men have fathers—please show mercy."

sentences.zh: 盜感之而止。

translations.literal: The bandits were moved and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were moved and stopped.

sentences.zh: 及前谷，又逢前盜，相告語曰：「此孝子也。」

translations.literal: When they reached the next valley they again met the former bandits, who said to one another: "This is a filial son."
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the next valley they again met the former bandits, who said to one another: "This is a filial son."

sentences.zh: 即同舉輿，延於其家，以帛封創，饘飲奉蔚。

translations.literal: They together lifted the litter, kept him at their home several days, wrapped cloth on the wound, and offered gruel to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: They together lifted the litter, kept him at their home several days, wrapped cloth on the wound, and offered gruel to Wei.

sentences.zh: 留之信宿，得達梁州。

translations.literal: After staying two nights they were able to reach Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After staying two nights they were able to reach Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 故吏感恩，爭來奔問。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xizong had already fled to Chengdu, Hui reached the traveling court and submitted a memorial begging to return and attend to illness.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xizong had already fled to Chengdu, Hui reached the traveling court and submitted a memorial begging to return and attend to illness.

sentences.zh: 時僖宗已幸成都，徽至行朝拜章，乞歸侍疾。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xizong had already fled to Chengdu, Hui reached the traveling court and submitted a memorial begging to return and attend to illness.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xizong had already fled to Chengdu, Hui reached the traveling court and submitted a memorial begging to return and attend to illness.

sentences.zh: 已除諫議大夫，不拜。

translations.literal: He had already been appointed Remonstrance Official but did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: He had already been appointed Remonstrance Official but did not accept.

sentences.zh: 謂宰相杜讓能曰：「願留兄循在朝，以當門戶，乞侍醫藥。」

translations.literal: He told Chancellor Du Rangneng: "I wish to leave my elder brother Xun at court to uphold the household gate and beg to attend to medicine."
translations.idiomatic: He told Chancellor Du Rangneng: "I wish to leave my elder brother Xun at court to uphold the household gate and beg to attend to medicine."

sentences.zh: 時循為給事中，丞相許之。

translations.literal: At that time Xun was Supervising Censor and the chancellor consented.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xun was Supervising Censor and the chancellor consented.

sentences.zh: 其年鐘家艱，執喪梁、漢。

translations.literal: That year he observed mourning for his mother's family; he kept mourning in Liang and Han.
translations.idiomatic: That year he observed mourning for his mother's family and kept mourning in Liang and Han.

sentences.zh: 既除，以中書舍人征，未赴，疾作。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was summoned as Palace Secretary but did not go; illness developed.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was summoned as Palace Secretary but did not go; illness developed.

sentences.zh: 以舍人綸制之地，不可曠官，請授散秩，改給事中。

translations.literal: Because the Palace Secretary's place drafts edicts and one cannot leave the office vacant, he requested a titular rank and was changed to Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Palace Secretary's place drafts edicts and one cannot leave the office vacant, he requested a titular rank and was changed to Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 從駕還京，至陳倉，疾甚，經年方間。

translations.literal: He followed the emperor returning to the capital; when he reached Chencang his illness was severe and only after a year did he recover.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the emperor returning to the capital. When he reached Chencang his illness was severe and only after a year did he recover.

sentences.zh: 宰相張浚為招討使，奏徽為判官，檢校左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Chancellor Zhang Jun as Pacification Commissioner memorialized Hui as judge and Acting Left Regular Cavalryman.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Zhang Jun as Pacification Commissioner memorialized Hui as judge and Acting Left Regular Cavalryman.

sentences.zh: 詔下鳳翔，促令赴闕。

translations.literal: When the edict reached Fengxiang he was urged to hurry to court.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict reached Fengxiang he was urged to hurry to court.

sentences.zh: 徽謂所親曰：「國步方艱，皇居初復，帑廩皆虛，正賴群臣協力，同心王室。

translations.literal: Hui told those close to him: "The state's step is now difficult and the imperial residence has just been restored; the treasury is all empty and we truly rely on all ministers to cooperate and join hearts with the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: Hui told those close to him: "The state's step is now difficult and the imperial residence has just been restored. The treasury is all empty and we truly rely on all ministers to cooperate and join hearts with the royal house.

sentences.zh: 而於破敗之余，圖雄霸之舉，俾諸侯離心，必貽後悔也。

translations.literal: Yet amid ruin they plot hegemonic enterprise and will make the feudal lords lose heart—this will surely bring later regret.
translations.idiomatic: Yet amid ruin they plot hegemonic enterprise and will make the feudal lords lose heart—this will surely bring later regret.

sentences.zh: 以吾衰疾之年，安能為之扞難。」

translations.literal: At my age of declining illness, how can I contend with such difficulty for them?"
translations.idiomatic: At my age of declining illness, how can I contend with such difficulty for them?"

sentences.zh: 辭疾不起。

translations.literal: He pleaded illness and did not rise.
translations.idiomatic: He pleaded illness and did not rise.

sentences.zh: 明年，浚敗，召徽為給事中。

translations.literal: The next year Jun was defeated and Hui was summoned as Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Jun was defeated and Hui was summoned as Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 楊復恭叛歸山南，李茂貞上表，請自出兵糧問罪，但授臣詔討使。

translations.literal: When Yang Fugong rebelled and returned to Shannan, Li Maozhen submitted a memorial requesting to march himself with army grain to punish the crime, asking only that an edict of punitive expedition be granted.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Fugong rebelled and returned to Shannan, Li Maozhen submitted a memorial requesting to march himself with army grain to punish the crime, asking only that an edict of punitive expedition be granted.

sentences.zh: 奏不待報，茂貞與王行瑜軍已出疆。

translations.literal: Without waiting for reply, Maozhen and Wang Xingyu's armies had already crossed the border.
translations.idiomatic: Without waiting for reply, Maozhen and Wang Xingyu's armies had already crossed the border.

sentences.zh: 上怒其專，不時可之，茂貞恃強，章疏不已。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry at their presumption and did not promptly approve; Maozhen relied on strength and memorials did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry at their presumption and did not promptly approve. Maozhen relied on strength and memorials did not cease.

sentences.zh: 昭宗延英召諫官宰相議可否。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhaozong at Yanying summoned remonstrating officials and chancellors to discuss whether it was permissible.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhaozong at Yanying summoned remonstrating officials and chancellors to discuss whether it was permissible.

sentences.zh: 以邠、鳳皆有中人內應，不敢極言，相顧辭遜，上情不悅。

translations.literal: Because Bin and Feng both had inner agents in collusion, they dared not speak fully; they looked at one another and spoke deferentially and the emperor's mood was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Because Bin and Feng both had inner agents in collusion, they dared not speak fully. They looked at one another and spoke deferentially and the emperor's mood was displeased.

sentences.zh: 徽奏曰：「兩朝多艱，茂貞實有翼衛之功，惡諸楊阻兵，意在嫉惡。

translations.literal: Hui memorialized: "The two reigns had many hardships; Maozhen truly had merit in guarding and protecting.
translations.idiomatic: Hui memorialized: "The two reigns had many hardships. Maozhen truly had merit in guarding and protecting.

sentences.zh: 所造次者，不俟命而出師也。

translations.literal: He hated the various Yangs for obstructing troops and his intent lay in detesting evil.
translations.idiomatic: He hated the various Yangs for obstructing troops and his intent lay in detesting evil.

sentences.zh: 近聞兩鎮兵入界，多有殺傷，陛下若不處分，梁、漢之民盡矣。

translations.literal: What he did hastily was to march without awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: What he did hastily was to march without awaiting orders.

sentences.zh: 須授以使名，明行約束，則軍中爭不畏法。」

translations.literal: I hear the two frontier armies entering the border have many killings and wounds; if Your Majesty does not dispose of this, the people of Liang and Han will all be gone."
translations.idiomatic: I hear the two frontier armies entering the border have many killings and wounds. If Your Majesty does not dispose of this, the people of Liang and Han will all be gone."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此言極是。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "These words are extremely right."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "These words are extremely right."

sentences.zh: 乃以招討之命授之。

translations.literal: The title of pacification commissioner was then granted.
translations.idiomatic: The title of pacification commissioner was then granted.

sentences.zh: 及茂貞平賊，自恃浸驕，多撓國政，命杜讓能料兵討之。

translations.literal: When Maozhen pacified the bandits he grew increasingly arrogant by his own reliance, frequently interfered in state affairs, and the emperor ordered Du Rangneng to plan troops to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: When Maozhen pacified the bandits he grew increasingly arrogant by his own reliance, frequently interfered in state affairs, and the emperor ordered Du Rangneng to plan troops to punish him.

sentences.zh: 徽諫曰：「岐是國門，茂貞倔強，不顧禍患。

translations.literal: Hui remonstrated: "Qi is the nation's gate; Maozhen is stubborn and does not heed calamity and harm.
translations.idiomatic: Hui remonstrated: "Qi is the nation's gate. Maozhen is stubborn and does not heed calamity and harm.

sentences.zh: 萬一蹉跌，挫國威也，不若漸以制之。」

translations.literal: If there is one misstep it will bruise the nation's prestige—it is better gradually to control him."
translations.idiomatic: If there is one misstep it will bruise the nation's prestige—it is better gradually to control him."

sentences.zh: 及師出，復召徽謂之曰：「卿能斟酌時事，岐軍烏合，朕料必平，卿以為捷在何日？」

translations.literal: When the army set out the emperor again summoned Hui and told him: "You can weigh current affairs; Qi's army is a rabble—I reckon it will surely be pacified. When do you think victory will come?"
translations.idiomatic: When the army set out the emperor again summoned Hui and told him: "You can weigh current affairs. Qi's army is a rabble—I reckon it will surely be pacified. When do you think victory will come?"

sentences.zh: 徽對曰：「臣忝侍從諫諍之列，所言軍國，據理陳聞。

translations.literal: Hui replied: "Your servant humbly serves in the ranks of attendants who remonstrate; what I speak of military and state affairs I present according to reason.
translations.idiomatic: Hui replied: "Your servant humbly serves in the ranks of attendants who remonstrate. What I speak of military and state affairs I present according to reason.

sentences.zh: 如破賊之期，在陛下考蓍龜，責將帥，非臣之職也。」

translations.literal: As for the date of defeating bandits, that lies in Your Majesty divining with yarrow and tortoise and charging generals—it is not your servant's office."
translations.idiomatic: As for the date of defeating bandits, that lies in Your Majesty divining with yarrow and tortoise and charging generals—it is not your servant's office."

sentences.zh: 而王師果衄，大臣被害。

translations.literal: The royal army was indeed defeated and great ministers were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: The royal army was indeed defeated and great ministers were harmed.

sentences.zh: 徽尋改中書舍人。

translations.literal: Hui was soon changed to Palace Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was soon changed to Palace Secretary.

sentences.zh: 歲中，遷刑部侍郎，封奇章男。

translations.literal: Within the year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Punishments and enfeoffed as Baron of Qizhang.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Punishments and enfeoffed as Baron of Qizhang.

sentences.zh: 崔胤連結汴州，惡徽言事，改散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Cui Yin linked with Bian Prefecture and hated Hui's speaking on affairs; he was changed to Regular Cavalryman.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yin linked with Bian Prefecture and hated Hui's speaking on affairs. He was changed to Regular Cavalryman.

sentences.zh: 不拜，換太子賓客。

translations.literal: He did not accept and was changed to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He did not accept and was changed to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 天復初，賊臣用事，朝政不綱，拜章請罷。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu wicked ministers wielded power and court politics lacked discipline; he submitted a memorial requesting dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianfu wicked ministers wielded power and court politics lacked discipline. He submitted a memorial requesting dismissal.

sentences.zh: 詔以刑部尚書致仕，乃歸樊川別墅。

translations.literal: An edict retired him as Minister of Punishments and he returned to his villa at Fanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict retired him as Minister of Punishments and he returned to his villa at Fanchuan.

sentences.zh: 病卒，贈吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He died of illness and was posthumously made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He died of illness and was posthumously made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 蕭俛，字思謙。

translations.literal: Xiaomian, styled Siqian.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaomian, styled Siqian.

sentences.zh: 曾祖太師徐國公嵩，開元中宰相。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather was Grand Preceptor Duke of Xu Kingdom Song, chancellor in the Kaiyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather was Grand Preceptor Duke of Xu Kingdom Song, chancellor in the Kaiyuan era.

sentences.zh: 祖華，襲徐國公，肅宗朝宰相。

translations.literal: His grandfather Hua inherited Duke of Xu Kingdom and was chancellor in the Suzong era.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Hua inherited Duke of Xu Kingdom and was chancellor in the Suzong era.

sentences.zh: 父恆，贈吏部尚書。

translations.literal: His father Heng was posthumously made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: His father Heng was posthumously made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 皆自有傳。

translations.literal: All have their own biographies.
translations.idiomatic: All have their own biographies.

sentences.zh: 俛，貞元七年進士擢第。

translations.literal: Mian, in the seventh year of Zhenyuan, was selected through the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Mian, in the seventh year of Zhenyuan, was selected through the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 元和初，復登賢良方正制科，拜右拾遺，遷右補闕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanhe he again passed the Exceptionally Qualified and Upright recruitment, was appointed Right Reminder, and promoted to Right Supplementation Official.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanhe he again passed the Exceptionally Qualified and Upright recruitment, was appointed Right Reminder, and promoted to Right Supplementation Official.

sentences.zh: 元和六年，召充翰林學士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanhe he was summoned as Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanhe he was summoned as Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 七年，轉司封員外郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Vice Director in the Bureau of Honors.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to Vice Director in the Bureau of Honors.

sentences.zh: 九年，改駕部郎中、知制誥，內職如故。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was changed to Director in the Bureau of Transport and Drafter of Imperial Edicts, his inner-court post remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was changed to Director in the Bureau of Transport and Drafter of Imperial Edicts, his inner-court post remaining as before.

sentences.zh: 坐與張仲方善，仲方駁李吉甫謚議，言用兵征發之弊，由吉甫而生。

translations.literal: He was punished for being friendly with Zhang Zhongfang; Zhongfang rejected Li Jifu's posthumous title discussion, speaking of the evils of military campaigns and conscription arising from Jifu.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished for being friendly with Zhang Zhongfang. Zhongfang rejected Li Jifu's posthumous title discussion, speaking of the evils of military campaigns and conscription arising from Jifu.

sentences.zh: 憲宗怒，貶仲方。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong was angry and demoted Zhongfang.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong was angry and demoted Zhongfang.

sentences.zh: 俛亦罷學士，左授太仆少卿。

translations.literal: Mian was also dismissed from the Academy and demoted to left as Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: Mian was also dismissed from the Academy and demoted to left as Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 十三年，皇甫镈用事，言於憲宗，拜俛御史中丞。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when Huangfu Bo wielded power, he spoke to Xianzong and Mian was appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, when Huangfu Bo wielded power, he spoke to Xianzong and Mian was appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 俛與镈及令狐楚，同年登進士第。

translations.literal: Mian, Bo, and Linghu Chu passed the jinshi examination in the same year.
translations.idiomatic: Mian, Bo, and Linghu Chu passed the jinshi examination in the same year.

sentences.zh: 明年，镈援楚作相，二人雙薦俛於上。

translations.literal: The next year Bo supported Chu as chancellor and the two together recommended Mian to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Bo supported Chu as chancellor and the two together recommended Mian to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 自是，顧眄日隆，進階朝議郎、飛騎尉，襲徐國公，賜緋魚袋。

translations.literal: From this imperial favor daily grew; he was advanced to Court Gentleman for Discussion and Flying Cavalryman, inherited Duke of Xu Kingdom, and was given crimson fish.
translations.idiomatic: From this imperial favor daily grew. He was advanced to Court Gentleman for Discussion and Flying Cavalryman, inherited Duke of Xu Kingdom, and was given crimson fish.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位之月，議命宰相，令狐楚援之，拜中書侍郎、平章事，仍賜金紫之服。

translations.literal: In the month of Muzong's accession, when a chancellor was discussed, Linghu Chu supported him; he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, Councilor of State, and still given gold-and-purple robes.
translations.idiomatic: In the month of Muzong's accession, when a chancellor was discussed, Linghu Chu supported him. He was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, Councilor of State, and still given gold-and-purple robes.

sentences.zh: 八月，轉門下侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he was transferred to Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was transferred to Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月，吐蕃寇涇原，命中使以禁軍援之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Tibet raided Jingyuan; an inner-court envoy was ordered to aid with palace troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Tibet raided Jingyuan. An inner-court envoy was ordered to aid with palace troops.

sentences.zh: 穆宗謂宰臣曰：「用兵有必勝之法乎？」

translations.literal: Muzong asked the chancellors: "Is there a method that must win in using troops?"
translations.idiomatic: Muzong asked the chancellors: "Is there a method that must win in using troops?"

sentences.zh: 俛對曰：「兵者兇器，戰者危事，聖主不得已而用之。

translations.literal: Mian replied: "Arms are baleful instruments and battle is a perilous affair; the sage ruler uses them only when he must.
translations.idiomatic: Mian replied: "Arms are baleful instruments and battle is a perilous affair. The sage ruler uses them only when he must.

sentences.zh: 以仁討不仁，以義討不義，先務招懷，不為掩襲。

translations.literal: To use benevolence to attack the unbenevolent and righteousness to attack the unrighteous, first work to win hearts—do not make surprise attacks.
translations.idiomatic: To use benevolence to attack the unbenevolent and righteousness to attack the unrighteous, first work to win hearts—do not make surprise attacks.

sentences.zh: 古之用兵，不斬祀，不殺厲，不擒二毛，不犯田稼。

translations.literal: In ancient use of arms one did not cut off sacrifices, did not kill the wounded, did not capture the gray-haired, and did not violate standing grain.
translations.idiomatic: In ancient use of arms one did not cut off sacrifices, did not kill the wounded, did not capture the gray-haired, and did not violate standing grain.

sentences.zh: 安人禁暴，師之上也。

translations.literal: To pacify the people and forbid violence is the highest of armies.
translations.idiomatic: To pacify the people and forbid violence is the highest of armies.

sentences.zh: 如救之甚於水火。

translations.literal: It is like rescue more urgent than fire and water.
translations.idiomatic: It is like rescue more urgent than fire and water.

sentences.zh: 故王者之師，有征無戰，此必勝之道也。

translations.literal: Therefore the king's army has campaigns but no battles—this is the way that must win.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the king's army has campaigns but no battles—this is the way that must win.

sentences.zh: 如或縱肆小忿，輕動干戈，使敵人怨結，師出無名，非惟不勝，乃自危之道也。

translations.literal: If one indulges small anger and lightly moves arms, making the enemy knit resentment and the army go forth without a righteous name, not only will one not win—it is the way of endangering oneself.
translations.idiomatic: If one indulges small anger and lightly moves arms, making the enemy knit resentment and the army go forth without a righteous name, not only will one not win—it is the way of endangering oneself.

sentences.zh: 固宜深慎！」

translations.literal: This truly should be deeply cautious!"
translations.idiomatic: This truly should be deeply cautious!"

sentences.zh: 帝然之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 時令狐楚左遷西川節度使，王播廣以貨幣賂中人權幸，求為宰相。

translations.literal: At that time Linghu Chu was demoted to military commissioner of Xichuan; Wang Bo widely used goods and currency to bribe powerful inner-court favorites and sought to be chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Linghu Chu was demoted to military commissioner of Xichuan. Wang Bo widely used goods and currency to bribe powerful inner-court favorites and sought to be chancellor.

sentences.zh: 而宰相段文昌復左右之。

translations.literal: Chancellor Duan Wenchang again supported him from the side.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Duan Wenchang again supported him from the side.

sentences.zh: 俛性嫉惡，延英面言播之纖邪納賄，喧於中外，不可以汙臺司。

translations.literal: Mian's nature detested evil; at Yanying he spoke face to face of Bo's wickedness and bribery, clamoring inside and outside that he could not defile the terrace offices.
translations.idiomatic: Mian's nature detested evil. At Yanying he spoke face to face of Bo's wickedness and bribery, clamoring inside and outside that he could not defile the terrace offices.

sentences.zh: 事已垂成，帝不之省，俛三上章求罷相任。

translations.literal: The matter was already nearly settled but the emperor did not examine it; Mian submitted three memorials begging to resign the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was already nearly settled but the emperor did not examine it. Mian submitted three memorials begging to resign the chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年正月，守左僕射，進封徐國公，罷知政事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Changqing he served as Left Vice Director of the Department of State, was advanced to Duke of Xu Kingdom, and ceased directing government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Changqing he served as Left Vice Director of the Department of State, was advanced to Duke of Xu Kingdom, and ceased directing government affairs.

sentences.zh: 俛居相位，孜孜正道，重慎名器。

translations.literal: While Mian held the chancellorship he diligently pursued the correct Way and heavily weighed name and office.
translations.idiomatic: While Mian held the chancellorship he diligently pursued the correct Way and heavily weighed name and office.

sentences.zh: 每除一官，常慮乖當，故鮮有簡拔而涉克深，然誌嫉奸邪，脫屣重位，時論稱之。

translations.literal: Each time he appointed an official he often feared impropriety; therefore few were selected and promoted yet he penetrated deeply, but his will detested the wicked and he cast off heavy rank—commentators praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Each time he appointed an official he often feared impropriety. Therefore few were selected and promoted yet he penetrated deeply, but his will detested the wicked and he cast off heavy rank—commentators praised him.

sentences.zh: 穆宗乘章武恢復之余，即位之始，兩河廓定，四鄙無虞。

translations.literal: Muzong, riding the surplus of Zhangwu restoration, at the beginning of his accession the two He regions were pacified and the four borders had no worry.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong, riding the surplus of Zhangwu restoration, at the beginning of his accession the two He regions were pacified and the four borders had no worry.

sentences.zh: 而俛與段文昌屢獻太平之策，以為兵以靜亂，時已治矣，不宜黷武，勸穆宗休兵偃武。

translations.literal: Mian and Duan Wenchang repeatedly presented strategies of great peace, holding that arms quiet disorder and the time was already governed—arms should not be profaned and they urged Muzong to rest troops and lay aside war.
translations.idiomatic: Mian and Duan Wenchang repeatedly presented strategies of great peace, holding that arms quiet disorder and the time was already governed—arms should not be profaned and they urged Muzong to rest troops and lay aside war.

sentences.zh: 又以兵不可頓去，請密語天下軍鎮有兵處，每年百人之中，限八人逃死，謂之「消兵」。

translations.literal: Also because troops could not suddenly be removed, they requested secretly telling all military posts with troops throughout the realm that of every hundred men each year eight might flee to death—this was called "reducing troops."
translations.idiomatic: Also because troops could not suddenly be removed, they requested secretly telling all military posts with troops throughout the realm that of every hundred men each year eight might flee to death—this was called "reducing troops."

sentences.zh: 帝既荒縱，不能深料，遂詔天下，如其策而行之。

translations.literal: The emperor was already dissolute and could not judge deeply; an edict then ordered the realm to act according to their plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was already dissolute and could not judge deeply. An edict then ordered the realm to act according to their plan.

sentences.zh: 而籓籍之卒，合而為盜，伏於山林。

translations.literal: The frontier-register soldiers combined and became bandits hiding in mountains and forests.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier-register soldiers combined and became bandits hiding in mountains and forests.

sentences.zh: 明年，硃克融、王廷湊復亂河朔，一呼而遺卒皆至。

translations.literal: The next year Zhu Kerong and Wang Tingcou again troubled Hebei; at one call the discharged soldiers all arrived.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Zhu Kerong and Wang Tingcou again troubled Hebei. At one call the discharged soldiers all arrived.

sentences.zh: 朝廷方征兵諸籓，籍既不充，尋行招募。

translations.literal: The court was then conscripting troops from the various frontier posts; the registers were insufficient and soon recruitment was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The court was then conscripting troops from the various frontier posts. The registers were insufficient and soon recruitment was carried out.

sentences.zh: 烏合之徒，動為賊敗，由是復失河朔，蓋「消兵」之失也。

translations.literal: Rabble gathered at a stroke often moved as bandits and were defeated—the two He regions were again lost; this was the error of "reducing troops."
translations.idiomatic: Rabble gathered at a stroke often moved as bandits and were defeated—the two He regions were again lost. This was the error of "reducing troops."

sentences.zh: 俛性介獨，持法守正。

translations.literal: Mian's nature was upright and solitary; he upheld law and kept to correctness.
translations.idiomatic: Mian's nature was upright and solitary. He upheld law and kept to correctness.

sentences.zh: 以己輔政日淺，超擢太驟，三上章懇辭僕射，不拜。

translations.literal: Because his own time assisting in government was short and advancement had been too sudden, he submitted three memorials earnestly declining the vice directorship and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Because his own time assisting in government was short and advancement had been too sudden, he submitted three memorials earnestly declining the vice directorship and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「蕭俛以勤事國，以疾退身，本末初終，不失其道，既罷樞務，俾居端揆。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Xiaomian diligently served the state and because of illness withdrew; beginning and end never lost the Way.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Xiaomian diligently served the state and because of illness withdrew. Beginning and end never lost the Way.

sentences.zh: 朕欲加恩超等，復吾前言。

translations.literal: I wish to add favor beyond measure and restore my former words.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to add favor beyond measure and restore my former words.

sentences.zh: 而繼有讓章，至於三四，敦諭頗切，陳乞彌堅。

translations.literal: Yet successive declining memorials came, to three or four; earnest instruction was quite pressing yet petitioning grew firmer.
translations.idiomatic: Yet successive declining memorials came, to three or four. Earnest instruction was quite pressing yet petitioning grew firmer.

sentences.zh: 成爾謙光，移之選部，可吏部尚書。」

translations.literal: Completing your modest humility, transfer to the Selection Bureau—he may be Minister of Personnel."
translations.idiomatic: Completing your modest humility, transfer to the Selection Bureau—he may be Minister of Personnel."

sentences.zh: 俛又以選曹簿書煩雜，非攝生之道，乞換散秩。

translations.literal: Mian also held that the Selection Bureau's documents were vexatiously complex and not the way to preserve life; he begged to exchange for a titular rank.
translations.idiomatic: Mian also held that the Selection Bureau's documents were vexatiously complex and not the way to preserve life. He begged to exchange for a titular rank.

sentences.zh: 其年十月，改兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year he was changed to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year he was changed to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 二年，以疾表求分司，不許。

translations.literal: In the second year he submitted illness and begged for titular assignment; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he submitted illness and begged for titular assignment; this was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 三月，改太子少保，尋授同州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third month he was changed to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and soon appointed prefect of Tong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was changed to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and soon appointed prefect of Tong.

sentences.zh: 寶歷二年，復以少保分司東都。

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoli he again served as Grand Tutor assigned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoli he again served as Grand Tutor assigned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 文宗即位，授檢校左僕射、守太子少師。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenzong acceded he was appointed Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenzong acceded he was appointed Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 俛稱疾篤，不任赴闕，乞罷所授官。

translations.literal: Mian claimed his illness was severe and he could not go to court; he begged to dismiss the office conferred.
translations.idiomatic: Mian claimed his illness was severe and he could not go to court. He begged to dismiss the office conferred.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「新除太子少師蕭俛，代炳臺耀，躬茂天爵。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The newly appointed Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Xiaomian succeeds a glorious terrace and personally possesses lofty heaven-rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "The newly appointed Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Xiaomian succeeds a glorious terrace and personally possesses lofty heaven-rank.

sentences.zh: 文可以經緯邦俗，行可以感動神祇。

translations.literal: In literature he can weave and govern custom; in conduct he can move spirits and gods.
translations.idiomatic: In literature he can weave and govern custom; in conduct he can move spirits and gods.

sentences.zh: 夷淡粹和，精深敏直，進退由道，周旋令名。

translations.literal: Calm, pure, harmonious, and refined, penetrating, keen, and upright, advance and retreat follow the Way and his reputation in society is excellent.
translations.idiomatic: Calm, pure, harmonious, and refined, penetrating, keen, and upright, advance and retreat follow the Way and his reputation in society is excellent.

sentences.zh: 近以師傅之崇，疇於舊德，俾從優逸，冀保養頤。

translations.literal: Recently, in honor of the tutor's eminence, he was matched to old virtue to obtain ease and comfort, hoping to preserve and nourish his years.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, in honor of the tutor's eminence, he was matched to old virtue to obtain ease and comfort, hoping to preserve and nourish his years.

sentences.zh: 而抗疏懇辭，勇退知止，嘗亦敦諭，確乎難拔。

translations.literal: Yet he resisted with earnest memorials, bravely withdrawing and knowing when to stop; earnest instruction was also given yet he was firmly immovable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he resisted with earnest memorials, bravely withdrawing and knowing when to stop. Earnest instruction was also given yet he was firmly immovable.

sentences.zh: 遂茲牢讓，以厚時風，可銀青光祿大夫、守尚書左僕射致仕。」

translations.literal: Thus this firm declination thickens the fashion of the time—he may be Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal, Left Vice Director of the Department of State, retired."
translations.idiomatic: Thus this firm declination thickens the fashion of the time—he may be Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal, Left Vice Director of the Department of State, retired."

sentences.zh: 俛趣尚簡潔，不以聲利自汙。

translations.literal: Mian inclined toward simplicity and did not defile himself with sound and profit.
translations.idiomatic: Mian inclined toward simplicity and did not defile himself with sound and profit.

sentences.zh: 在相位時，穆宗詔撰《故成德軍節度使王士真神道碑》，對曰：「臣器褊狹，此不能強。

translations.literal: While in the chancellorship Muzong ordered the composition of the Spirit Way Stele for the late Wang Shizhen, military commissioner of Chengde Army; he replied: "Your servant's capacity is narrow and cramped—I cannot force this.
translations.idiomatic: While in the chancellorship Muzong ordered the composition of the Spirit Way Stele for the late Wang Shizhen, military commissioner of Chengde Army. He replied: "Your servant's capacity is narrow and cramped—I cannot force this.

sentences.zh: 王承宗先朝阻命，事無可觀，如臣秉筆，不能溢美。
