translations.literal: Wang Chengzong in the former reign resisted orders—there is nothing to view in the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengzong in the former reign resisted orders—there is nothing to view in the matter.

sentences.zh: 或撰進之後，例行貺遺。

translations.literal: Or after it is drafted and submitted, gifts are routinely bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Or after it is drafted and submitted, gifts are routinely bestowed.

sentences.zh: 臣若公然阻絕，則違陛下撫納之宜；

translations.literal: If I openly refuse I violate Your Majesty's intent to soothe and accept;
translations.idiomatic: If I openly refuse I violate Your Majesty's intent to soothe and accept;

sentences.zh: 僶俛受之，則非微臣平生之誌。

translations.literal: if I humbly accept it is not your servant's lifelong intent.
translations.idiomatic: if I humbly accept it is not your servant's lifelong intent.

sentences.zh: 臣不願為之秉筆。」

translations.literal: Your servant does not wish to take up the brush for this."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant does not wish to take up the brush for this."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉而免之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and excused him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and excused him.

sentences.zh: 俛家行尤孝。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and excused him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and excused him.

sentences.zh: 母韋氏，賢明有禮，理家甚嚴。

translations.literal: Mian's family conduct was especially filial.
translations.idiomatic: Mian's family conduct was especially filial.

sentences.zh: 俛雖為宰相，侍母左右，不異褐衣時。

translations.literal: His mother, Lady Wei, was wise and had propriety and managed the household very strictly.
translations.idiomatic: His mother, Lady Wei, was wise and had propriety and managed the household very strictly.

sentences.zh: 丁母喪，毀瘠逾制。

translations.literal: Though Mian was chancellor, attending at his mother's side he was no different than when he wore coarse cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Though Mian was chancellor, attending at his mother's side he was no different than when he wore coarse cloth.

sentences.zh: 免喪，文宗征詔，懇以疾辭。

translations.literal: When his mother died his grief and emaciation exceeded the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died his grief and emaciation exceeded the regulations.

sentences.zh: 既致仕於家，以洛都官屬賓友，避歲時請謁之煩，乃歸濟源別墅，逍遙山野，嘯詠窮年。

translations.literal: When mourning ended Wenzong summoned him by edict; he earnestly pleaded illness.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended Wenzong summoned him by edict; he earnestly pleaded illness.

sentences.zh: 八年，以莊恪太子在東宮，上欲以耆德輔導，復以少師征之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because the Heir Apparent Zhuangke was in the Eastern Palace, the emperor wished to use aged virtue to assist and guide and again summoned him as Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, because the Heir Apparent Zhuangke was in the Eastern Palace, the emperor wished to use aged virtue to assist and guide and again summoned him as Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 俛令弟傑奉表京師，復納制書，堅辭痼疾。

translations.literal: Mian had his younger brother Jie submit a memorial to the capital, again returning the appointment edict, firmly declining chronic illness.
translations.idiomatic: Mian had his younger brother Jie submit a memorial to the capital, again returning the appointment edict, firmly declining chronic illness.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「不待年而求謝，於理身之道則至矣，其如朝廷之望何？

translations.literal: An edict said: "Not waiting for years to seek leave—in the Way of preserving the person this is utmost; but what of the court's expectation?
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Not waiting for years to seek leave—in the Way of preserving the person this is utmost; but what of the court's expectation?

sentences.zh: 朕以肇建元良，精求師傅，遐想漢朝故事，玄成、石慶，當時重德，鹹歷此官。

translations.literal: I, having newly established the Heir Apparent, carefully seek tutors; I recall Han dynasty precedent—Xuancheng and Shi Qing, heavy in virtue at the time, all held this office.
translations.idiomatic: I, having newly established the Heir Apparent, carefully seek tutors. I recall Han dynasty precedent—Xuancheng and Shi Qing, heavy in virtue at the time, all held this office.

sentences.zh: 吾以元子幼沖，切於師訓，欲以敕汝發明古今，冀忠孝之規，日聞於耳。

translations.literal: Because my eldest son is young and tender I am keen on tutor's instruction, wishing to charge you to clarify ancient and modern, hoping the norms of loyalty and filial piety daily reach the ear.
translations.idiomatic: Because my eldest son is young and tender I am keen on tutor's instruction, wishing to charge you to clarify ancient and modern, hoping the norms of loyalty and filial piety daily reach the ear.

sentences.zh: 特遣左右，至於林園。

translations.literal: I specially sent attendants to your woodland garden.
translations.idiomatic: I specially sent attendants to your woodland garden.

sentences.zh: 而卿高蹈翛然，屏絕趨進，復遣令弟還召詔書。

translations.literal: Yet you stride high and are detached, screening off all approach; again I sent your younger brother to return and summon the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Yet you stride high and are detached, screening off all approach. Again I sent your younger brother to return and summon the edict.

sentences.zh: 天爵自優，冥鴻方遠，不轉之誌，其堅若山。

translations.literal: Heaven-rank is self-superior and the dark swan is far—your unbending intent is firm as mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven-rank is self-superior and the dark swan is far—your unbending intent is firm as mountains.

sentences.zh: 循省來章，致煩為愧。

translations.literal: Reviewing the submitted memorial brings repeated embarrassment.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing the submitted memorial brings repeated embarrassment.

sentences.zh: 終以呂尚之秩，遂其疏曠之心。

translations.literal: Finally with the rank of Lü Shang I fulfill your detached and spacious heart.
translations.idiomatic: Finally with the rank of Lü Shang I fulfill your detached and spacious heart.

sentences.zh: 勵俗激貪，所補多矣。

translations.literal: Encouraging custom and stirring against greed—this repairs much.
translations.idiomatic: Encouraging custom and stirring against greed—this repairs much.

sentences.zh: 有益於政，寄聲以聞，亦有望於舊臣矣。

translations.literal: What benefits government, send word to be heard—I also have hope in the old minister.
translations.idiomatic: What benefits government, send word to be heard—I also have hope in the old minister.

sentences.zh: 可太子太傅致仕。」

translations.literal: He may be Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, retired."
translations.idiomatic: He may be Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, retired."

sentences.zh: 開成二年，俛弟俶授楚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaicheng Mian's younger brother Chou was appointed prefect of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kaicheng Mian's younger brother Chou was appointed prefect of Chu.

sentences.zh: 辭日，文宗謂俶曰：「蕭俛先朝名相，觔力未衰，可一來京國。

translations.literal: On the day of leave-taking Wenzong told Chou: "Xiaomian was a famed chancellor of the former reign; his strength is not yet decayed—he may come once to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of leave-taking Wenzong told Chou: "Xiaomian was a famed chancellor of the former reign. His strength is not yet decayed—he may come once to the capital.

sentences.zh: 朕賜俛詔書匹帛，卿便賫至濟源，道吾此意。」

translations.literal: I bestow on Mian edict books and bolts of silk—you may carry them to Jiyuan and convey my intent."
translations.idiomatic: I bestow on Mian edict books and bolts of silk—you may carry them to Jiyuan and convey my intent."

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「卿道冠時髦，業高儒行。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Your Way crowns the eminent of the age and your conduct towers among Confucian practice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Your Way crowns the eminent of the age and your conduct towers among Confucian practice.

sentences.zh: 著作礪濟川之效，弘致君匡國之規，留芳巖廊，逸老林壑。

translations.literal: Repeatedly descending commendatory edicts and swiftly adding honored rank—yet your intent cannot be wrested and feeling appears in your words.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly descending commendatory edicts and swiftly adding honored rank—yet your intent cannot be wrested and feeling appears in your words.

sentences.zh: 累降褒詔，亟加崇秩，而誌不可奪，情見乎辭。

translations.literal: The great swan flies into the dark; chanting and thought increase sighs.
translations.idiomatic: The great swan flies into the dark; chanting and thought increase sighs.

sentences.zh: 鴻飛入冥，吟想增嘆。

translations.literal: Now bestowing three hundred bolts of silk—let Xiao Chou proclaim it.
translations.idiomatic: Now bestowing three hundred bolts of silk—let Xiao Chou proclaim it.

sentences.zh: 今賜絹三百匹，便令蕭俶宣示。」

translations.literal: Mian ultimately did not rise and died."
translations.idiomatic: Mian ultimately did not rise and died."

sentences.zh: 俛竟不起，卒。

translations.literal: Jie, styled Haoshi.
translations.idiomatic: Jie, styled Haoshi.

sentences.zh: 傑，字豪士。

translations.literal: Mian ultimately did not rise and died.
translations.idiomatic: Mian ultimately did not rise and died.

sentences.zh: 元和十二年登進士第。

translations.literal: Jie, styled Haoshi.
translations.idiomatic: Jie, styled Haoshi.

sentences.zh: 累官侍御史，遷主客員外郎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yuanhe he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Yuanhe he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 太和九年十月，鄭註為鳳翔節度使，慎選參佐。

translations.literal: He repeatedly served as Attending Censor and was promoted to Vice Director in the Bureau of Receptions.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly served as Attending Censor and was promoted to Vice Director in the Bureau of Receptions.

sentences.zh: 李訓以傑檢校工部郎中，充鳳翔隴觀察判官。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the ninth year of Taihe, Zheng Zhu was military commissioner of Fengxiang and carefully selected aides.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the ninth year of Taihe, Zheng Zhu was military commissioner of Fengxiang and carefully selected aides.

sentences.zh: 其年十一月，鄭註誅，傑為鳳翔監軍使所害。

translations.literal: Li Xun had Jie made Acting Director in the Ministry of Works and Fengxiang-Long Observation Commissioner judge.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xun had Jie made Acting Director in the Ministry of Works and Fengxiang-Long Observation Commissioner judge.

sentences.zh: 俶以廕授官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of that year when Zheng Zhu was executed, Jie was killed by the Fengxiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of that year when Zheng Zhu was executed, Jie was killed by the Fengxiang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太和中，累遷至河南少尹。

translations.literal: Chou received office by hereditary privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Chou received office by hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，拜諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he was repeatedly promoted to Vice Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he was repeatedly promoted to Vice Governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 開成二年，出為楚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year he was appointed Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year he was appointed Remonstrance Official.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，遷越州刺史、御史中丞、浙東都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaicheng he went out as prefect of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kaicheng he went out as prefect of Chu.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，入為左散騎常侍，遷檢校刑部尚書、華州刺史、潼關防禦等使。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year he was transferred to prefect of Yue, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Zhedong defense and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year he was transferred to prefect of Yue, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Zhedong defense and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 大中初，坐在華州時斷獄不法，授太子賓客分司。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he entered court as Left Regular Cavalryman and was transferred to Acting Minister of Punishments, prefect of Hua, and Tong Pass defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era he entered court as Left Regular Cavalryman and was transferred to Acting Minister of Punishments, prefect of Hua, and Tong Pass defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四年，檢校戶部尚書、兗州刺史、兗沂海節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he was punished for unlawful judgment of cases while in Hua and was appointed Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent assigned to titular duty.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he was punished for unlawful judgment of cases while in Hua and was appointed Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent assigned to titular duty.

sentences.zh: 石對曰：「比日苦寒，蓋刑殺太過，致此陰沴。

translations.literal: Shi replied: "These days are bitterly cold—probably executions are too many and caused this yin affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Shi replied: "These days are bitterly cold—probably executions are too many and caused this yin affliction.

sentences.zh: 昨聞鄭註到鳳翔，招募士卒不至，捕索誅夷不已，臣恐邊上聞之，乘此生事。

translations.literal: Yesterday I heard Zheng Zhu reached Fengxiang and could not recruit soldiers; searching and executing without end—I fear the frontier hearing this will take advantage and cause trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday I heard Zheng Zhu reached Fengxiang and could not recruit soldiers, searching and executing without end. I fear the frontier hearing this will take advantage and cause trouble.

sentences.zh: 宜降詔安喻其心。」

translations.literal: An edict should be sent to soothe their hearts."
translations.idiomatic: An edict should be sent to soothe their hearts."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 江西、湖南兩道觀察使以新經訓、註之亂，吏卒多死，進官健衣糧一百二十分，充宰相募召從人。

translations.literal: The Jiangxi and Hunan observation commissioners, because of the recent Xun and Zhu turmoil in which many clerks and soldiers died, presented one hundred twenty portions of official soldiers' clothing and grain to recruit followers for the chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi and Hunan observation commissioners, because of the recent Xun and Zhu turmoil in which many clerks and soldiers died, presented one hundred twenty portions of official soldiers' clothing and grain to recruit followers for the chancellors.

sentences.zh: 石奏曰：「宰相上弼聖政，下理群司。

translations.literal: Shi memorialized: "Chancellors above assist sacred government and below govern all offices.
translations.idiomatic: Shi memorialized: "Chancellors above assist sacred government and below govern all offices.

sentences.zh: 若忠正無私，宗社所祐，縱逢盜賊，兵不能傷；

translations.literal: If upright and without selfishness the ancestral temple is aided—even meeting bandits, arms cannot harm them;
translations.idiomatic: If upright and without selfishness the ancestral temple is aided—even meeting bandits, arms cannot harm them;

sentences.zh: 若事涉隱欺，心懷矯妄，雖有防衛，鬼得而誅。

translations.literal: if affairs involve hidden deception and the heart harbors falsehood, though there is defense, ghosts can execute them.
translations.idiomatic: if affairs involve hidden deception and the heart harbors falsehood, though there is defense, ghosts can execute them.

sentences.zh: 臣等願推赤心以答聖獎。

translations.literal: We wish to offer red hearts to answer sacred reward.
translations.idiomatic: We wish to offer red hearts to answer sacred reward.

sentences.zh: 孟軻知非臧氏，孔子不畏匡人。

translations.literal: Mencius knew Zang was not the thief; Confucius did not fear the men of Kuang.
translations.idiomatic: Mencius knew Zang was not the thief; Confucius did not fear the men of Kuang.

sentences.zh: 其兩道所進衣糧，並望停寢，依從前制置，只以金吾手力引從。」

translations.literal: The clothing and grain presented by the two circuits—I hope all will be stopped and rest on former arrangements, using only Golden Guard manpower for escort."
translations.idiomatic: The clothing and grain presented by the two circuits—I hope all will be stopped and rest on former arrangements, using only Golden Guard manpower for escort."

sentences.zh: 可之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 帝又曰：「宰相之任，在選賢任能。」

translations.literal: The emperor also said: "The chancellor's charge lies in selecting the worthy and employing the able."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also said: "The chancellor's charge lies in selecting the worthy and employing the able."

sentences.zh: 石曰：「臣與鄭覃常以此事為切，但以人各有求，茍遂所欲則美譽至，稍不如意則謗議生。

translations.literal: Shi said: "Your servant and Zheng Tan often take this matter as urgent, but because each man has his seeking—if his desire is met praise arrives, if slightly not as wished slander arises.
translations.idiomatic: Shi said: "Your servant and Zheng Tan often take this matter as urgent, but because each man has his seeking—if his desire is met praise arrives, if slightly not as wished slander arises.

sentences.zh: 只宜各委所司薦用，臣等擇可授之，則物議息矣。」

translations.literal: It is only proper to entrust each office with recommendation; we select those who may be appointed—then public discussion will cease."
translations.idiomatic: It is only proper to entrust each office with recommendation. We select those who may be appointed—then public discussion will cease."

sentences.zh: 其年十二月，中使田全操、劉行深巡邊回，走馬入金光門。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year the inner envoy Tian Quancao and Liu Xingshen returned from patrolling the frontier and galloped through the Golden Light Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of that year the inner envoy Tian Quancao and Liu Xingshen returned from patrolling the frontier and galloped through the Golden Light Gate.

sentences.zh: 從者訛言兵至，百官朝退，倉惶駭散。

translations.literal: Followers falsely cried that troops had arrived; officials leaving court scattered in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Followers falsely cried that troops had arrived. Officials leaving court scattered in alarm.

sentences.zh: 有不及束帶、襪而乘者。

translations.literal: Some could not fasten belts or socks before mounting.
translations.idiomatic: Some could not fasten belts or socks before mounting.

sentences.zh: 市人叫噪，塵坌四起。

translations.literal: Market people shouted; dust rose on all sides.
translations.idiomatic: Market people shouted; dust rose on all sides.

sentences.zh: 二相在中書，人吏稍散。

translations.literal: The two chancellors were in the Secretariat; clerks and attendants somewhat dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: The two chancellors were in the Secretariat; clerks and attendants somewhat dispersed.

sentences.zh: 鄭覃曰：「耳目頗異，且宜出去。」

translations.literal: Zheng Tan said: "Eyes and ears are quite strange—it is better to go out for now."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tan said: "Eyes and ears are quite strange—it is better to go out for now."

sentences.zh: 石曰：「事勢不可知，但宜堅坐鎮之，冀將寧息。

translations.literal: Shi said: "The situation cannot be known; one should only sit firmly and calm it, hoping it will settle.
translations.idiomatic: Shi said: "The situation cannot be known. One should only sit firmly and calm it, hoping it will settle.

sentences.zh: 若宰相亦走，則中外亂矣。

translations.literal: If chancellors also flee, inside and outside will be disordered.
translations.idiomatic: If chancellors also flee, inside and outside will be disordered.

sentences.zh: 必若繼亂，走亦何逃？

translations.literal: If disorder continues, fleeing also—where can one escape?
translations.idiomatic: If disorder continues, fleeing also—where can one escape?

sentences.zh: 任重官崇，人心所屬，不可忽也。」

translations.literal: Heavy responsibility and lofty office—the people's hearts belong to us; this cannot be slighted."
translations.idiomatic: Heavy responsibility and lofty office—the people's hearts belong to us. This cannot be slighted."

sentences.zh: 石視簿書，沛然自若。

translations.literal: Shi looked at documents, calm and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Shi looked at documents, calm and at ease.

sentences.zh: 京城無賴之徒，皆戎服兵仗，北望闕門以俟變。

translations.literal: Ruffians of the capital all wore military dress and weapons, looking north toward the palace gate awaiting change.
translations.idiomatic: Ruffians of the capital all wore military dress and weapons, looking north toward the palace gate awaiting change.

sentences.zh: 內使連催閉皇城門，金吾大將軍陳君賞率其徒立望仙門下，謂中使曰：「假如有賊，閉門不晚。

translations.literal: Inner attendants repeatedly urged closing the imperial city gate; Golden Guard General Chen Junshang led his men standing below Wangxian Gate and told the inner attendant: "If there are bandits, closing the gate is not late.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants repeatedly urged closing the imperial city gate. Golden Guard General Chen Junshang led his men standing below Wangxian Gate and told the inner attendant: "If there are bandits, closing the gate is not late.

sentences.zh: 請徐觀其變，無宜自弱。」

translations.literal: Please slowly observe the change—one should not weaken oneself."
translations.idiomatic: Please slowly observe the change—one should not weaken oneself."

sentences.zh: 晡晚方定。

translations.literal: Toward evening it was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Toward evening it was settled.

sentences.zh: 是日，茍非石之鎮靜，君賞之禦侮，幾將亂矣。

translations.literal: That day, if not for Shi's calm and Junshang's defense, disorder was nearly upon them.
translations.idiomatic: That day, if not for Shi's calm and Junshang's defense, disorder was nearly upon them.

sentences.zh: 開成元年，改元，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaicheng the era name was changed and a great amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaicheng the era name was changed and a great amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 石等商量節文，放京一年租稅。

translations.literal: Shi and others discussed the provisions and released one year's rent and tax for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shi and others discussed the provisions and released one year's rent and tax for the capital.

sentences.zh: 及正、至、端午進奉，並停三年，其錢代充百姓紐配錢。

translations.literal: New Year, Winter Solstice, and Double Fifth tribute offerings were all stopped for three years; the money substituted for the people's cloth allocation tax.
translations.idiomatic: New Year, Winter Solstice, and Double Fifth tribute offerings were all stopped for three years. The money substituted for the people's cloth allocation tax.

sentences.zh: 諸道除藥物、口味、茶果外，不得進獻。

translations.literal: The various circuits, aside from medicines, delicacies, tea, and fruit, could not present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The various circuits, aside from medicines, delicacies, tea, and fruit, could not present tribute.

sentences.zh: 諸司宣索制造，並停三年。

translations.literal: All offices' imperial demands for manufacture were stopped for three years.
translations.idiomatic: All offices' imperial demands for manufacture were stopped for three years.

sentences.zh: 赦後，紫宸宣對。

translations.literal: After the amnesty there was Zichen audience.
translations.idiomatic: After the amnesty there was Zichen audience.

sentences.zh: 鄭覃曰：「陛下改元禦殿，全放京畿一年租稅，又停天下節鎮進奉。

translations.literal: Zheng Tan said: "Your Majesty changed the era name and held court, fully releasing one year's rent and tax for the capital region and also stopping tribute from frontier posts throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tan said: "Your Majesty changed the era name and held court, fully releasing one year's rent and tax for the capital region and also stopping tribute from frontier posts throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 恩澤所該，實當要切。

translations.literal: The grace extended is truly essential and urgent.
translations.idiomatic: The grace extended is truly essential and urgent.

sentences.zh: 近年赦令，皆不及此。」

translations.literal: In recent years amnesty edicts have not reached this."
translations.idiomatic: In recent years amnesty edicts have not reached this."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕務行其實，不欲崇長空文。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I strive to enact the real and do not wish to exalt empty text."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I strive to enact the real and do not wish to exalt empty text."

sentences.zh: 石對曰：「赦書須內置一本，陛下時省覽之。

translations.literal: Shi replied: "The amnesty text must have one copy placed within; Your Majesty should occasionally review it.
translations.idiomatic: Shi replied: "The amnesty text must have one copy placed within. Your Majesty should occasionally review it.

sentences.zh: 十道黜陟使發日，付與公事根本，令與長吏詳擇施行，方盡利害之要。」

translations.literal: When the ten-circuit demotion and promotion commissioners depart, deliver to them the root of public affairs and have them with local elders carefully choose and implement—then the essentials of benefit and harm will be fully exhausted."
translations.idiomatic: When the ten-circuit demotion and promotion commissioners depart, deliver to them the root of public affairs and have them with local elders carefully choose and implement—then the essentials of benefit and harm will be fully exhausted."

sentences.zh: 石以從前德音雖降，人君不能守，奸吏從而違之，故有內置之奏以諷之。

translations.literal: Shi, because former benevolent edicts though issued rulers could not keep them and wicked clerks violated them, therefore had this inner placement memorial to admonish.
translations.idiomatic: Shi, because former benevolent edicts though issued rulers could not keep them and wicked clerks violated them, therefore had this inner placement memorial to admonish.

sentences.zh: 尋加中書侍郎、集賢殿大學士，領鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and head of the Salt and Iron Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was advanced to Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and head of the Salt and Iron Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 上御紫宸論政曰：「為國之道，致治甚難。」

translations.literal: The emperor at Zichen discussed government: "The Way of governing the state—bringing order is very difficult."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at Zichen discussed government: "The Way of governing the state—bringing order is very difficult."

sentences.zh: 石對曰：「朝廷法令行則易。

translations.literal: Shi replied: "When court laws and orders are executed it is easy.
translations.idiomatic: Shi replied: "When court laws and orders are executed it is easy.

sentences.zh: 臣聞文王陟降在上，陛下推赤誠，上達於天，何憂不治？」

translations.literal: I hear King Wen ascended and descended above; Your Majesty extends red sincerity reaching heaven—why worry about not governing?"
translations.idiomatic: I hear King Wen ascended and descended above. Your Majesty extends red sincerity reaching heaven—why worry about not governing?"

sentences.zh: 上又曰：「治亂由人邪正，由時運耶？」

translations.literal: The emperor also said: "Does order and disorder come from men's orthodoxy and perversity, or from the time's fortune?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also said: "Does order and disorder come from men's orthodoxy and perversity, or from the time's fortune?"

sentences.zh: 鄭覃對曰：「由聖帝，由忠臣，是由人也。」

translations.literal: Zheng Tan replied: "From the sacred emperor and loyal ministers—it is from men."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tan replied: "From the sacred emperor and loyal ministers—it is from men."

sentences.zh: 石曰：「亦由時運。

translations.literal: Shi said: "It is also from the time's fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Shi said: "It is also from the time's fortune.

sentences.zh: 九廟聖靈，鐘德於陛下，時也；

translations.literal: The spirits of the nine temples concentrated virtue upon Your Majesty—that is the time;
translations.idiomatic: The spirits of the nine temples concentrated virtue upon Your Majesty—that is the time;

sentences.zh: 陛下行己之道，則是由人。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's conduct is then from men.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's conduct is then from men.

sentences.zh: 而前代帝王甚有德者，當亂離無奈何之際，又安得不推運耶？」

translations.literal: Yet former emperors very virtuous, when in chaotic separation at wit's end, how could they not defer to fortune?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet former emperors very virtuous, when in chaotic separation at wit's end, how could they not defer to fortune?"

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿言是也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Your words are right."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Your words are right."

sentences.zh: 石又奏：「咸陽令韓遼請開興成渠。

translations.literal: Shi also memorialized: "Xianyang magistrate Han Liao requests opening the Xingcheng Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Shi also memorialized: "Xianyang magistrate Han Liao requests opening the Xingcheng Canal.

sentences.zh: 舊漕在咸陽縣西十八里，東達永豐倉，自秦、漢已來疏鑿，其後堙廢。

translations.literal: The old transport was eighteen li west of Xianyang County, reaching east to Yongfeng Granary; since Qin and Han it was dredged and later silted and abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: The old transport was eighteen li west of Xianyang County, reaching east to Yongfeng Granary. Since Qin and Han it was dredged and later silted and abandoned.

sentences.zh: 昨遼計度，用功不多。

translations.literal: Liao's recent estimate requires not much labor.
translations.idiomatic: Liao's recent estimate requires not much labor.

sentences.zh: 此漕若成，自咸陽抵潼關，三百里內無車挽之勤，則轅下牛盡得歸耕，永利秦中矣。」

translations.literal: If this transport is completed, from Xianyang to Tong Pass for three hundred li there is no cart-hauling toil—then capital oxen can all return to plowing and Guanzhong will benefit forever."
translations.idiomatic: If this transport is completed, from Xianyang to Tong Pass for three hundred li there is no cart-hauling toil. Then capital oxen can all return to plowing and Guanzhong will benefit forever."

sentences.zh: 李固言曰：「王涯已前已曾陳奏，實秦中之利，但恐征役今非其時。」

translations.literal: Li Guyun said: "Before Wang Ya it was already memorialized—truly Guanzhong's benefit, but I fear conscript labor is not timely now."
translations.idiomatic: Li Guyun said: "Before Wang Ya it was already memorialized—truly Guanzhong's benefit, but I fear conscript labor is not timely now."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「莫有陰陽拘忌否？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Are there yin-yang taboos?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Are there yin-yang taboos?

sentences.zh: 茍利於人，朕無所慮也。」

translations.literal: If it benefits the people I have no concern."
translations.idiomatic: If it benefits the people I have no concern."

sentences.zh: 石辭領使務。

translations.literal: Shi declined heading the commission.
translations.idiomatic: Shi declined heading the commission.

sentences.zh: 八月，罷鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Salt and Iron Transport Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Salt and Iron Transport Commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 石用金部員外郎韓益判度支案，益坐贓系臺。

translations.literal: Shi used Jin Ministry Vice Director Han Yi to judge treasury cases; Yi was imprisoned for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Shi used Jin Ministry Vice Director Han Yi to judge treasury cases. Yi was imprisoned for corruption.

sentences.zh: 石奏曰：「臣以韓益曉錢穀錄用之，不謂貪猥如此！」

translations.literal: Shi memorialized: "Your servant employed Yi because he understood money and grain—I did not expect such greed and baseness!"
translations.idiomatic: Shi memorialized: "Your servant employed Yi because he understood money and grain—I did not expect such greed and baseness!"

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「宰相但知人則用，有過則懲。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The chancellor only employs those he knows; when there is fault then punish.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The chancellor only employs those he knows; when there is fault then punish.

sentences.zh: 卿所用人，且不掩其惡，可謂至公。

translations.literal: Those you employ and do not cover their wickedness—this may be called utmost fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Those you employ and do not cover their wickedness—this may be called utmost fairness.

sentences.zh: 從前宰相用人，有過曲為蔽之，不欲人彈劾，此大謬也。

translations.literal: Former chancellors employing men, when there was fault curved to hide it, not wishing people to impeach—this is greatly wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Former chancellors employing men, when there was fault curved to hide it, not wishing people to impeach—this is greatly wrong.

sentences.zh: 但知能則舉，舉不失職則獎之，自然易得其人，何必容隱。」

translations.literal: Only know ability then raise; raise without losing office then reward—naturally easy to get the right men; why must one conceal?"
translations.idiomatic: Only know ability then raise; raise without losing office then reward—naturally easy to get the right men. Why must one conceal?"

sentences.zh: 三年正月五日，石自親仁裏將曙入朝，盜發於故郭尚父宅；

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the first month of the third year Shi from Qinren Lane was about to enter court at dawn; bandits broke into the former residence of Guo the late father-in-law;
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the first month of the third year Shi from Qinren Lane was about to enter court at dawn. Bandits broke into the former residence of Guo the late father-in-law;

sentences.zh: 引弓追及，矢才破膚，馬逸而回。

translations.literal: pursuing with bow he was reached; the arrow only broke skin and the horse bolted and turned.
translations.idiomatic: pursuing with bow he was reached. The arrow only broke skin and the horse bolted and turned.

sentences.zh: 盜已伏坊門，揮刀斫石，斷馬尾，竟以馬逸得還私第。

translations.literal: The bandit already lay in wait at the ward gate, swung blade and struck Shi, severed the horse's tail, yet by the horse's bolt he returned to his private residence.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit already lay in wait at the ward gate, swung blade and struck Shi, severed the horse's tail, yet by the horse's bolt he returned to his private residence.

sentences.zh: 上聞之駭愕，遣中使撫問，賜金瘡藥，因差六軍兵士三十人衛從宰相。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard he was startled, sent an inner-court envoy to comfort and inquire, bestowed gold and wound medicine, and dispatched thirty Six Army soldiers to guard the chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard he was startled, sent an inner-court envoy to comfort and inquire, bestowed gold and wound medicine, and dispatched thirty Six Army soldiers to guard the chancellors.

sentences.zh: 是日，京師大恐，常參官入朝者，九人而已，旬日方安。

translations.literal: That day the capital was greatly afraid; officials entering regular audience numbered only nine; only after ten days was it settled.
translations.idiomatic: That day the capital was greatly afraid. Officials entering regular audience numbered only nine; only after ten days was it settled.

sentences.zh: 石拜章辭位者三。

translations.literal: Shi submitted memorials resigning office three times.
translations.idiomatic: Shi submitted memorials resigning office three times.

sentences.zh: 乃加金紫光祿大夫、中書侍郎、同平章事、江陵尹、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: He was then advanced to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate Councilor of State, Metropolitan Governor of Jiangling, and military commissioner of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was then advanced to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate Councilor of State, Metropolitan Governor of Jiangling, and military commissioner of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 李訓之亂，人情危迫，天子起石於常僚之中，付以衡柄。

translations.literal: In Li Xun's turmoil people's hearts were perilous; the Son of Heaven raised Shi from among regular officials and entrusted him with the balance of power.
translations.idiomatic: In Li Xun's turmoil people's hearts were perilous. The Son of Heaven raised Shi from among regular officials and entrusted him with the balance of power.

sentences.zh: 石以身徇國，不顧患難，振舉朝綱，國威再復。

translations.literal: Shi gave himself for the state without regard for hardship, raised court discipline, and national prestige was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Shi gave himself for the state without regard for hardship, raised court discipline, and national prestige was restored.

sentences.zh: 而中官仇士良切齒惡之，而伏戎加害。

translations.literal: Yet inner-court eunuch Qiu Shiliang gnashed teeth in hatred and hidden foes added harm.
translations.idiomatic: Yet inner-court eunuch Qiu Shiliang gnashed teeth in hatred and hidden foes added harm.

sentences.zh: 天子深知其故，畏逼而不能理，乃至罷免。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven deeply knew the reason yet feared coercion and could not judge—thus to dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven deeply knew the reason yet feared coercion and could not judge—thus to dismissal.

sentences.zh: 及石赴鎮，賜宴之儀並闕，人士傷之，恥君子之道消也。

translations.literal: When Shi went to his post the banquet rites were all lacking; gentlemen were wounded and ashamed that the way of the noble man was fading.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi went to his post the banquet rites were all lacking. Gentlemen were wounded and ashamed that the way of the noble man was fading.

sentences.zh: 石至鎮，表讓中書侍郎，乃加檢校兵部尚書、兼平章事。

translations.literal: When Shi reached his post he memorialized declining Vice Director of the Secretariat and was advanced to Acting Minister of War and Associate Councilor of State.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi reached his post he memorialized declining Vice Director of the Secretariat and was advanced to Acting Minister of War and Associate Councilor of State.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，就加檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wuzong acceded he was advanced to Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong acceded he was advanced to Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State.

sentences.zh: 會昌三年十月，加檢校司空、平章事、隴西郡開國伯、食邑七百戶、太原尹、北都留守、河東節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Huichang he was advanced to Acting Minister of Works, Councilor of State, Baron of Longxi with seven hundred households, Metropolitan Governor of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and military commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of Huichang he was advanced to Acting Minister of Works, Councilor of State, Baron of Longxi with seven hundred households, Metropolitan Governor of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and military commissioner of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 時澤潞劉稹阻兵，以石嘗為太原副使，諳練北門軍政，故代劉沔鎮之。

translations.literal: At that time Zelu Liu Zhen resisted with troops; because Shi had once been vice commissioner of Taiyuan and was versed in Northern Gate military government, he replaced Liu Mian to govern.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zelu Liu Zhen resisted with troops. Because Shi had once been vice commissioner of Taiyuan and was versed in Northern Gate military government, he replaced Liu Mian to govern.

sentences.zh: 初，沔以兵三千人戍橫水。

translations.literal: Initially Mian had three thousand troops garrison Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Mian had three thousand troops garrison Hengshui.

sentences.zh: 王師之討澤潞也，王逢軍於榆社，訴兵少，請益之，詔石以太原之卒赴榆社。

translations.literal: When the royal army attacked Zelu, Wang Feng's army was at Yushe and complained troops were few and begged reinforcement; an edict ordered Shi to send Taiyuan troops to Yushe.
translations.idiomatic: When the royal army attacked Zelu, Wang Feng's army was at Yushe and complained troops were few and begged reinforcement. An edict ordered Shi to send Taiyuan troops to Yushe.

sentences.zh: 石乃割橫水戍卒一千五百人，令別將楊弁率之，以赴王逢。

translations.literal: Shi then cut one thousand five hundred from the Hengshui garrison and ordered Vice General Yang Bian to lead them to join Wang Feng.
translations.idiomatic: Shi then cut one thousand five hundred from the Hengshui garrison and ordered Vice General Yang Bian to lead them to join Wang Feng.

sentences.zh: 舊例發軍，人給二縑。

translations.literal: By former precedent when troops were dispatched each man was given two bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: By former precedent when troops were dispatched each man was given two bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 石以支計不足，量減一匹，軍人聚怨。

translations.literal: Shi because expenditure accounts were insufficient measured and reduced by one bolt; soldiers gathered resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Shi because expenditure accounts were insufficient measured and reduced by one bolt. Soldiers gathered resentment.

sentences.zh: 又將及歲除，促令上路，眾愈不悅。

translations.literal: Also as year-end drew near they were urged to set out on the road; the crowd grew more displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Also as year-end drew near they were urged to set out on the road. The crowd grew more displeased.

sentences.zh: 楊弁乘其釁謀亂，出言激動軍人。

translations.literal: Yang Bian seized the opening to plot rebellion and spoke to incite the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Bian seized the opening to plot rebellion and spoke to incite the soldiers.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，軍亂逐石，朝廷乃以晉絳觀察使崔元式代還。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year the army rebelled and drove out Shi; the court then sent Jin-Jiang Observation Commissioner Cui Yuanshi to replace and return.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year the army rebelled and drove out Shi. The court then sent Jin-Jiang Observation Commissioner Cui Yuanshi to replace and return.

sentences.zh: 五年，檢校司徒、東都留守、判東都尚書省事、畿汝都防禦使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was made Acting Minister of Works, Eastern Capital Garrison Commander, directing Eastern Capital Department of State affairs, and Defense Commissioner of Ji and Ru.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made Acting Minister of Works, Eastern Capital Garrison Commander, directing Eastern Capital Department of State affairs, and Defense Commissioner of Ji and Ru.

sentences.zh: 以太子少保分司卒。

translations.literal: He died as Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent assigned to titular duty.
translations.idiomatic: He died as Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent assigned to titular duty.

sentences.zh: 石弟福，字能之。

translations.literal: Shi's younger brother Fu, styled Nengzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Shi's younger brother Fu, styled Nengzhi.

sentences.zh: 太和七年登進士第，累辟使府。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Taihe he passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to commissioner staffs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Taihe he passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to commissioner staffs.

sentences.zh: 石為宰相，自薦弟於延英，言福才堪理人，授監察御史。

translations.literal: When Shi was chancellor he recommended his younger brother at Yanying, saying Fu's talent sufficed to govern people, and appointed him Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi was chancellor he recommended his younger brother at Yanying, saying Fu's talent sufficed to govern people, and appointed him Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 累遷尚書郎，出為商、鄭、汝、潁四州刺史。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Director in a ministry and went out as prefect of Shang, Zheng, Ru, and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Director in a ministry and went out as prefect of Shang, Zheng, Ru, and Ying.

sentences.zh: 大中時，檢校工部尚書、滑州刺史、兼御史大夫，充義成軍節度、鄭滑潁觀察使。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong era he was made Acting Minister of Works, prefect of Hua, concurrently Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of Yicheng Army and observation commissioner of Zheng-Hua-Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dazhong era he was made Acting Minister of Works, prefect of Hua, concurrently Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of Yicheng Army and observation commissioner of Zheng-Hua-Ying.

sentences.zh: 入為刑部侍郎，累遷刑部、戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He entered court as Vice Minister of Punishments and was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Punishments and Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Vice Minister of Punishments and was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Punishments and Revenue.

sentences.zh: 乾符初，以檢校右僕射、襄州刺史、兼御史大夫充山南東道節度。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianfu he was made Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State, prefect of Xiang, concurrently Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qianfu he was made Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State, prefect of Xiang, concurrently Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 四年，草賊王仙芝徒黨數萬寇掠山南。

translations.literal: In the fourth year grass bandit Wang Xianzhi's followers numbered tens of thousands raiding Shannan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year grass bandit Wang Xianzhi's followers numbered tens of thousands raiding Shannan.

sentences.zh: 福團練鄉兵，屯集要路，賊不敢犯。

translations.literal: Fu trained local militia, gathered at strategic points, and the bandits dared not violate.
translations.idiomatic: Fu trained local militia, gathered at strategic points, and the bandits dared not violate.

sentences.zh: 其秋，賊陷嶽、鄂、饒、信等州。

translations.literal: That autumn the bandits seized Yue, E, Rao, and Xin prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the bandits seized Yue, E, Rao, and Xin prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月，逼江陵，節度使楊知溫求援於福；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they pressed Jiangling; Military Commissioner Yang Zhiwen begged aid from Fu;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they pressed Jiangling. Military Commissioner Yang Zhiwen begged aid from Fu;

sentences.zh: 福即自率州兵及沙阤五百騎赴援。

translations.literal: Fu immediately led prefectural troops and five hundred Shatuo cavalry to aid.
translations.idiomatic: Fu immediately led prefectural troops and five hundred Shatuo cavalry to aid.

sentences.zh: 時賊已陷江陵之郛，聞福兵至，乃退去。

translations.literal: When the bandits had already seized Jiangling's outer city and heard Fu's troops had arrived they then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits had already seized Jiangling's outer city and heard Fu's troops had arrived they then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 僖宗嘉之，就加檢校司空、同平章事。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong approved and advanced him to Acting Minister of Works and Associate Councilor of State.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong approved and advanced him to Acting Minister of Works and Associate Councilor of State.

sentences.zh: 歸朝，終於太子太傅。

translations.literal: Returning to court he ended as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to court he ended as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：彭陽奇章，起徒步而升臺鼎。

translations.literal: The historian says: Pengyang Qizhang rose from commoner to terrace and tripod.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: Pengyang Qizhang rose from commoner to terrace and tripod.

sentences.zh: 觀其人文彪炳，潤色邦典，射策命中，橫絕一時，誠俊賢也。

translations.literal: Observing his literary brilliance adorning and enriching state statutes, hitting the target in policy examinations, transcending his age—truly he was outstanding talent.
translations.idiomatic: Observing his literary brilliance adorning and enriching state statutes, hitting the target in policy examinations, transcending his age—truly he was outstanding talent.

sentences.zh: 而峨冠曳組，論道於臯、夔之伍，孰曰不然？

translations.literal: Yet with high cap and trailing ribbons, discussing the Way among the ranks of Gao Yao and Kui—who would say otherwise?
translations.idiomatic: Yet with high cap and trailing ribbons, discussing the Way among the ranks of Gao Yao and Kui—who would say otherwise?

sentences.zh: 如能蹈道匪躬，中立無黨，則其善盡矣。

translations.literal: If he could tread the Way without self, stand neutral without faction, then his goodness would be complete.
translations.idiomatic: If he could tread the Way without self, stand neutral without faction, then his goodness would be complete.

sentences.zh: 蕭太師貞獨嫉惡，不為利回，不以夷、惠儗之，俾之經綸，則其道至矣。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Xu was uniquely upright and detested evil, not turned by profit, not compared to Bo Yi or Hui of Liu—entrust him with weaving the realm and then his Way would reach utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Xu was uniquely upright and detested evil, not turned by profit. Not compared to Bo Yi or Hui of Liu—entrust him with weaving the realm and then his Way would reach utmost.

sentences.zh: 開成之始，帝道方淪，石於此時欲振頹緒，幾嬰戕賊，可為咄嗟。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaicheng the imperial Way was sinking; Shi at this time wished to revive the declining thread and nearly met slaughter—a matter for exclamation.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaicheng the imperial Way was sinking. Shi at this time wished to revive the declining thread and nearly met slaughter—a matter for exclamation.

sentences.zh: 多僻之時，止堪太息。

translations.literal: In a time of many perversities one can only sigh deeply.
translations.idiomatic: In a time of many perversities one can only sigh deeply.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：喬松孤立，蘿蔦夤緣。

translations.literal: Softly attaching and soaring aloft—can this be called able and worthy?
translations.idiomatic: Softly attaching and soaring aloft—can this be called able and worthy?

sentences.zh: 柔附淩雲，豈曰能賢？

translations.literal: Softly attaching and soaring aloft—can this be called able and worthy?
translations.idiomatic: Softly attaching and soaring aloft—can this be called able and worthy?

sentences.zh: 嗚呼楚、孺，道喪曲全！

translations.literal: Alas Chu and Sengru—the Way lost yet wholly preserved!
translations.idiomatic: Alas Chu and Sengru—the Way lost yet wholly preserved!

sentences.zh: 蕭、李相才，致之外篇。

translations.literal: Xiao and Li had chancellor talent—set beyond this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao and Li had chancellor talent—set beyond this chapter.
